chapters.title: The Connotation of the Fire - Part Two
chapters.html:
we are still talking in these lessons about the reason

which pushes the disobedie

nt to get in the fire in the

Doomsday and still mentioning the Trust which we bore

and how we promised the Almighty God before our

coming to this worldly life to keep it and to be faithful in

shouldering it, and to be kind and humane with what the

Alm

ighty Al’lah created and exploited for our benefits,

that we must not treat them with inequity, stress, or

overexerting them and don’t go outside our rights with

any creatures even with the one who harms us or does

wrong with us, we have the right to t

reat him as he treats

us but it’s much better if we forgive him with our ability

to handle him such as he does. Even the harmful insects

or animals we have the right to get rid of its harm and

danger, but it is forbidden to attack them in their

dwelli

ngs unless they go outside their functions trying to

hurt us, thus every creature has a function in this

universe, it wasn’t created in vain and all of them are

utilized for us in a direct or indirect way as we have

mentioned in the previous lesson.

B

ut we have to notice that we can’t keep the Trust

without God’s help in order to attain the Godly light to be

able to take the straight path and walk in it without falling

in the darkness and shunning the truth by following our

desires supposing that o

ur acts are good.

Actually, if we don’t perform and keep the Trust in

our speech and deeds we cannot face and get nearer to the

Almighty God, however the human could lie or cheat

others but not himself.

“Nay! Man will be a witness against himself. Tho

ugh he may put forth his excuses”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress Al-Qiyamah, verse (14-15)

The spirit wouldn’t be able to attain the link with the

Almighty God if it wasn’t confident of its deeds, but

moreover its bad deed would become as a veil to it!

“N

ay! But on their hearts is the covering which they

used to earn”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 83, Al-Mutaffifin (Defrauding), verse ﴿14﴾

The human can hide his errors and sins from all the

creatures except the Almighty God because He is the All-

knowing o

f everything, therefore how will man face the

One who treats him with all kinds of charities and

benevolences?

What extreme limit the hearty force of a man gets to,

he wouldn’t be able to face the one who did well with him

while he did bad with him, t

he same thing is in the

Doomsday, man will witness how the Almighty Al’lah has

been overwhelming him with His kindness, benevolence

and the bounties and how he has wrongly and meanly

reacted with that, so he will down his head full of shame

and disgra

ce.

“And if you only could see when the disbelievers

shall hang their heads before their lord saying: Our

lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back we

will do righteous good deeds, Verily! We now believe

with certainty”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortr

ess ﴿32﴾ As-Sajda (The Prostration) verse ﴿12﴾

Indeed they are certain (in the Dooms Day) that

getting in Paradise requires righteous good deeds, and

their deeds in the worldly life were full of cheat, lies,

malice, deceiving and what appeared well was

just for a

worldly benefit not for attaining God’s satisfaction.

“And you will see them brought forward to it made

humble by disgrace, looking with stealthy glance. And

those who believe will say: Verily, the losers are they

who lose themselves and t

heir families on the Day of

Resurrection. Verily, the wrong doer will be in a lasting

torment”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 42, Ash-Shura (Consultation), verse ﴿45﴾

The Almighty God granted us our nourishment in our

mother’s wombs then provided us with de

licious milk

through their breasts, and put the mercy in their hearts

where they became tired to take care of us, they awakened

all night when we got ill, preferred us to be fed before

they were, indeed that mercy which they overwhelms us

with is not

their own self-mercy but it is a Mercy form

the Almighty God Who has deposited it in their hearts.

As we get tired He grants us a quiet and peaceful

night, takes our freedom of choice (by sleeping) to rest

our bodies from their tiredness, then gives it

back to us

(in the morning)that we may have His Benevolence and

graces by doing good deeds and He utilizes everything in

the universe such as animals, plants and materials to

serve us.

Isn’t that treating a truthful evidence of His Mercy

with us, H

is love, Sympathy toward us? And after all that

Divine kind, how could we meet the Almighty God (our

Creator) if we reacted with His goodness by wrongness

and with His charity with denying!?

Then, what is our pretext if we think that He is

oppressive,

unjust and unmerciful (Al’lah is High above

all that)? How could we draw ourselves to Him if we were

wrongdoers with other creatures which He loves and

utilizes them to serve us and for our benefits? How could

people deny all that bounties which He ov

erwhelms them

every moment!? Or how do they disbelieve despite His

clear signs and wonders? And how would they forget all

His benevolence if they got something bad?! But if they

knew even that misfortune is in its reality a goodness for

them, because

it comes to awaken them from their

negligence and repel their shunning God, though it is a

result of their bad actions, moreover God the Almighty

forgives many of their bad deeds.

In the Judgment Day, when the human will see his

forfeiture of losing t

he paradise with all its boons of

seeing the Almighty God’s beautiful Face and losing the

lofty rank that he was nominated to have, he fell down to

the lower-ranked of all creatures', indeed it is a great

forfeiture, more than could be imagined, where

he lost “his lofty rank” in exchange of a slight pleasure during

not more than countable days in this worldly life,

therefore he would have the great regret and sorrow that

he wasted it and met the Almighty God with a dirty

clothes holding the snakes a

nd the scorpions (his bad and

hurting deeds) instead of the valuable presents such as

saving or helping others to get out from the darkness to

the Godly Light and to the straight path to get the

nearness to the Almighty God, the white and light-faced

and more close to the Almighty Al’lah where he attains

the real lasting pleasure, the happiness and the lofty

paradises, so after he would see that he lost all that and

see how he took the shells without the pearls and held the

waste instead of the jew

els, and therein it is the exam

results and everything comes to the end, indeed it is the

time of sorrow and extreme regret, wherein the regret

bites his heart, there is no one to be blamed except

himself, it’s the end and everything is finished, no ho

pe

or wish for him, how much it is difficult to live after

losing hope!?

The disbelievers lost their families, friends and

everyone else and they would be busy trying to hide their

depravities tarnished clothes, they deprived themselves of

having the

real lasting happiness and from having their

lofty rank.

“So worship what you like beside Him, The losers

are those who will lose themselves and their families on

the Day of Resurrection. Verily, that will be a manifest

loss! ”

The Holy Qur’an,

For

tress ﴿39﴾ Az-Zumar (The Groups), verse ﴿15﴾

Those who lose everything even their hope, what can

make them forget their state except the Fire? As the

Almighty God offered them the fire as suitable mercy to

them to be as a relief from their shocking spir

itual pain,

shame and distresses in order to forget their severe

spiritual torment, however every human will have the fire

according to his shunning God and negligence to relieve

him from his shocking spiritual torment.

“Verily, those who put into a

trial the believing men

and believing women, and then do not turn in

repentance will have the torment of the Hill, and they

will have the punishment of the burning fire”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress

85, Al-Buruj (Constellations), verse ﴿10﴾

Therefore, a

fter having the greatest forfeiture and

betraying their promise (they didn’t keep the Trust which

they bore), they will request to have salvation from their

horrible, painful spiritual torment, so the Almighty God

will turn them into the Fire torment w

hich is much lesser

than their intolerable and outstanding inner pains, that’s

indicated to in the Holy verse:

“a Day when they will be captivated with the fire, Taste you your captivation! this is what you used to

ask to be hastened”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿51﴾ Adh-Dhariyat (Sun Rays), verses (13-14)

They will be captivated with the fire as a patient who

is captivated with the relieving medicines.

“Shame will adhere to man on doomsday until he

says: Oh! My Provider, your sending me to fire is e

asier

than what I am suffering, although he knows the great

torture in it” ﴿22﴾

The Almighty God says:

“those are they who have

purchased error at the price of Guidance, and torment at

the price of forgiveness, so what is the thing which

makes them pati

ent with the fire!”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿2﴾ Al-Baqara (The Cow), verse ﴿175﴾

“the close of their request (the two parties; the

people of Paradise and the people of the Fire) will be:

All the praises and thanks are to God, the Supplier of

all w

orlds”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿10﴾ Yunus (Jonah), verse ﴿10﴾

The Fire is the most suitable treatment for the

disbelievers for their shocking spiritual torment.

As we have known before by the Prophetic noble

saying that the fire becomes as a hospita

l for the

wrongdoers who request it to have a salvation from their

horrible spiritual pain and absolutely the Merciful God

doesn’t force them to dwell in it.

The Almighty Al’lah says:

“They will say

:

Ah, would that I had put

forward (goodness) for m

y life (that was to

come)!, However, on that Day their torture will

not be inflicted upon them by anyone (other than

themselves), Nor will any bind their bonds over

them”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 89, Al-Fajr (The Dawn), verse (24- ﴿26﴾

“They will sa

y: Ah, would that I had put forward

(goodness) for my life (that was to come)!”

A

t this time,

they will feel great regret and their heart will break with

sorrow. They will see that the only real life is the life of

the other world, but alas! They will

have lost their

opportunity, and will have done nothing to allow

themselves to enjoy it.

“However, on that Day their torture will not be

inflicted upon them by anyone

other than

themselves

”

That is, none will torture them. They themselves

have in

curred whatever takes place. The pain and the

shame they will live in, along with their evil deeds which

will be standing before their eyes, will cause them

unbearable and insufferable agony in the depths of their

spirit. Therefore they will rush to th

e Fire to throw

themselves into it, wishing for the pain of its torturous

burning to help them to forget their spiritual pains.

I say, the situation of this person on this Day is like

the example of a child whose father warned it against

touching a sh

arp blade. The child did not follow its

father’s guidance and did what he had cautioned it

against. The child tried to sharpen its pencil with a sharp

blade, thinking that it would be better than the pencil

sharpener which its father had advised it to

use.

Inadvertently, the child mistakes the pencil for his

finger, thus cutting it. The child will then begin to cry and

to call on its father for help, appealing to him to bandage

the wound and relieve the pain.

I wonder: has anyone caused this child

the suffering

which befell it at that moment? Of course not!

Nobody caused that agony but the child, who has

drawn the pain to itself. Sterilizing the wound and

dressing it will also cause pain for the child, but this is

only done for the purpose of h

ealing.

This example makes the truth clearer in our minds,

even though the truth is far deeper than this. Anyone who

disobeys Al’lah and His Envoy strays far indeed, and

incurs a great loss.

The Almighty described the state of such miserable

failure

in some detail. He says:

“Nor will any bind their bonds over them.”

That is, on that Day none will confine that poor

unfortunate to the Fire; they themselves will remain

therein voluntarily.

They will put up with the pain of burning and oblige

themse

lves to bear their torment in order to forget their

suffering.

This is a clear description of the state of the

disobedient in the Day of Resurrection, so there is no way

for man to be saved from this horrible situation which

will lead him in Judgment

Day to throw himself in the

Fire except his instant repentance and returning to the

straight path, before it is too late.

If not, they will captivate with the Fire as the patient

who captivates with a relieving medicine or surgical

operation even with

a hard prescription just to have a

relief from his great pain and illness.

“a Day when they will be captivated with the fire”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 51, Adh-Dhariyat (Sun Rays), verse ﴿13﴾

They will know that the Fire is the best suitable thing

for their situation and they have to dwell in it.

“They are the dwellers of the fire, they will abide

therein forever”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿7﴾ Al-A'raf (The Heights), verse ﴿36﴾

We seek refuge in the Almighty God from our

spirit's evils, in ord

er that the Fire will not be our hurried

necessity.

So, the fire of the disbelievers' inner regret, shame

and disgrace, this horrible spiritual fire will burn their

hearts, then they will not find better treatment than the

Fire to treat their spiritua

l illness and relieve their severe

spiritual fire, so they themselves dwell in it seeking its

relief, absolutely God doesn’t aggress them but they do.

That is, none will torture them. They themselves

have incurred whatever takes place. The pain and the

shame they will live in, along with their evil deeds which

will be standing before their eyes, will cause them

unbearable and insufferable agony in the depths of their

spirit. Therefore they will rush to the Fire to throw

themselves into it, wishing

the pain of its torturous

burning will help them to forget their spiritual pains.

Indeed if we take a look at the actual life of the

human, if he had a horrible pain in one of his organs, and

realized that there was no solution except cutting that

org

an to be cured, he would surely surrender himself to

the doctor, appealing and requesting him to get the

salvation by cutting that organ, despite his knowledge of

the severe pain that would be after the cutting.

That is his state in the worldly life, s

o how his state

will be in the Hereafter? When his spirit is free from its

yearnings veils after death, returning to its nature the

nature of perfection, and awakes after a deep sleep to

remember his promise and how he had broken it, and he

sees his g

reat forfeiture of the paradises and his lowness

after losing his high rank in shouldering the trust while

the mountains, earth and heavens feared from shouldering

it, but after he promised his Almighty Lord to keep the

Trust, he turned to his desires

and yearning to the lowest

level until he lost hope, no one can live without hope,

moreover he lost his opportunity to see the Almighty

God’s beautiful Face Who is the Spring of Favour,

Goodness, Beauty and Perfection.

Then, he will be

overwhelmed by

disgrace and shame, burnt by his error

and malice deeds, and he will throw himself to the fire

which will burn his skin and face, and will drink very hot

water which amputates their abdomens, despite that he

favoured it in order to be cured from his h

orrible,

spiritual pains.

Our praises and thanks are to the

Almighty God in joy and in sorrow, in misfortune and

comfort, where He created the human to be in happiness

by witnessing his Beauty and Graces, putting him in a

lofty position, but he shunn

ed his Creator and engaged

himself in the low worldly life to be in a bad position,

however if he came in the Hereafter wearing a cloth full

of error and shame resulted from his bad deeds, the

Almighty God would not leave him alone with his

spiritual

pain and sorrow but He would have mercy on

him by offering him the fire to make him forget his

horrible, spiritual pain which is much severe than the

burning Fire, our praise is to God in the Beginning, the

End and in every state

:

“the close of their r

equest (the

two parties; the people of Paradise and the people of the

Fire) will be: All the praises and thanks are to God,

the Supplier of all worlds”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿10﴾ Yunus (Jonah), verse ﴿10﴾

chapters.title: Lesson Thirteen
chapters.html:
The Reality of Paradise

After we have known the

state of the evildoer in

Doomsday and how he will request the fire for himself,

which is a hospital he will have a proper treatment

through its burning for his severe spiritual status,

therefore we must move in this lesson to another

important subjec

t which is ‘

Paradise

’, so what is

Paradise which the Almighty God has promised His

obedient with?

The Connotation of Paradise

The word "paradise" is not only indicated to those

materialistic pleasures, or to have an enjoyment through

seeing a beaut

iful place with many blooming trees, flowing

rivers, varied fruits and extended shadows, however those

things or anything from the tangible things don’t give the

human a paradise even if it has several kinds of tangible

pleasures except by having,besid

es that, the spiritual

happiness and the abstract pleasure inside his heart that’s

indeed where he will find the real Paradise.

To explain more, we say: Suppose that there are two

students living in a adorable place that the eye has never

seen like it

before. While they are sitting one of them is

informed a great news of his success in his last exam and

of being granted a decree to have a highly position of a

new job. On the other hand the date of the latter’s exam

approaches and the means of trans

port, which will take him

to the place of the exam, is late. I wonder! Is the latter’s

inner state like the first one?

No doubt, the state of the first one as being in

paradise according to his inner happiness and pleasure, is

completely different fr

om that of the second one as being

in Hell according to his worry and confusion.

The word

‘Paradise’

in Arabic means Jan’nah which

is derived from the word jan'na, which means to cover

and hide something, accordingly "Jan’nah"in its reality

expresses

a status of graceful inner feelings of spiritual

happiness and pleasure veiled from other people, only the

owner of this pleasing feelings feels and enjoys them and

no one other than him is acquainted with them, as it is

indicated in the noble Propheti

c saying:

“If you pass by

the gardens of Paradise then stay and enjoy them. then

they asked the Prophet: What are the gardens of

Paradise? He said: the assemblies in which the

Almig

hty Al’lah is truly mentioned”. ﴿23﴾

And he (cpth)

said:

“Between my tomb

and platform there is one of

the gardens of Paradise, and my platform on my

basin” ﴿24﴾

.

You see, the Prophet (cpth) indicated the place which

is between his holy tomb and platform as one of the

gardens of the paradise, that is due to the inner Divine

sub

lime pleasure that the believer finds in his heart which

is resulted from the established link which links the

believer's spirit who sits there to the noble Prophet's spirit

(cpth), so he attains through this noble company of the

Prophet the nearness

to the Almighty Al’lah and that high

spiritual pleasure, actually it’s the same state with the

aforementioned assemblies, therefore the believer in the

Hereafter will continuously get nearer to God and flow

from one God’s bliss to a higher and more won

derful one

without stopping according to his nearness to the

Almighty God.

In addition to the spiritual enjoyment the

spirit will have a materialistic enjoyment as it will have

all its desires from fruits, foods, flowing rivers of

materialistic benef

actions, this materialistic pleasure will

increase according to the inner spiritual one, one by one

without limit, that’s indicated to in the holy God’s saying:

“…Every time will be provided with a fruit there from,

they will say: ‘This is what we we

re provided with

before’ and they will be given things in resemblance…”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 2, Al-Baqara (the Cow), verse ﴿25﴾

As mentioned before, although the fruits have the

same shape but the believer finds in his spirit an

increasing contin

ual enjoyment through their tastes, how

happy will the people of Paradise be! Glory to Him the

Almighty! What a Generous Granter He is! His favors

have no limits or end. After we have introduced for the

"Paradise" subject, we must cite the story of ou

r Master

Adam "peace be upon him", we say:

The Almighty God ordered our Master Adam to live

with his wife in the Paradise, to attain the endless favor of

witnessing the Godly Perfection and Beauties and to be

near to the Almighty God, moreover, He ord

ered them to

eat whatever they want from it.

But what is the reality of this eating? And how do the

dwellers of Paradise eat from it?

It is necessary to shed light upon the state of people

in Paradise and how they will enjoy themselves therein.

This

is important in order to recognize the limitless

Favour of Al’lah, the Almighty, for humanity, as well as

His great Graces. We say:

As previously mentioned, each person is composed

of a spirit, soul and body.

We have explained that the spirit is the

main element

of a person it is the subtle consciousness of man. It is a

Godly light and its centre is in the chest. Its rays spread to

all parts of the body through the nerves. This spirit,

confined to the body, is aware of its surroundings through

th

e five senses. It sees with the eye, hears with the ear,

smells with the nose, feels and touches with the skin and

tastes flavors with the tongue, which is also used to

express ideas and thoughts.

In more detail: we say that if one stands by the sea

shore, undoubtedly, through watching the sea, his

awareness will make him revere and glorify it. This

submission and glorification comes from the ‘spirit’.

If we see someone dear to us whose hand is bleeding

because it is badly wounded, we feel sorry for him, and

sympathize with him. This pain and grief also comes

from the ‘spirit’.

If we hear that we passed an exam or something

important, we feel pleased and happy to know this. These

feelings of pleasure and happiness are possible because of

the ‘spirit’. Thus, the spirit is the essential component of

man. It glorifies and submits, grieves, annoys, delights,

rejoices, feels contentment and anger, tastes, enjoys and

suffers. It is the centre of our existence.

The soul is a Godly light whose rays flow through

the body by means of blood to supply human with life,

accordingly supplies the human heart (the real tangible

heart in the chest) with life, and supplies the heart with

blood which completes the circle of life. If that supply to

a living creation is stopped, the body will become lifeless

and motionless, so the soul and the spirit differ from each

other, thus the body and the soul work as servants to the

spirit to help it perform any deeds.

However, in this world the spirit is confined within

and surrounded by the body. It perceives only pictures ‘images’, and enjoys delights by means of the physical

senses, so the spirit enjoys not directly but behind a veil

of body.

This situation is not like that in the life to come. In

the other abode, the spirit will envelop the body and

surround it on all sides, as the flame of a candle

completely surrounds its wick.

If we suppose that the wick of a candle is a body,

then its flame and its light would be the spirit, however,

we were only spirits before our existence in this life and

we will return as we were and as our Master Adam

“

pth

”

was, as the Almighty God says:

“…As He

brought you in the beginning, so shall you be brought

into being”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿7﴾ Al-A'raf (The Heights), verse ﴿29﴾

In the afterlife, the state of man's spirit will differ

from the worldly life's one, it will not see with the

physical eye or hear with the physical ear. The entire

spirit will be eyes and ears, and it will taste, smell and

speak with its entire self, without using any organ, In this

case, its taste will be great, its witnessing vast and its

bliss perfect, that is the state of the spirit on that Day.

Accordingly, it will get more pleasure there than it

does here. Its enjoyment now is but partial, indirect and

behind a veil, while on that day it will be complete and

direct, as the human feels hungry in the worldly life then

finds a pleasure in eating food, after he eats a limited

quantity of food he feels satisfied and fed up, but in

Paradise he will not appease and will not be bored from

eating or drinking, that’s indicated to through this holy

verse, the Almighty God says:

“Verily, you have a

promise that you will never be hungry therein nor naked. And you will suffer not from thirst therein nor

from the sun heat”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿20﴾ Ta Ha 'Ta-ha' (Pure), verses (118- ﴿119﴾

When the spirit wants to look at something in the life

to come, it will be in no need of an eye, just as it will not

need a mouth or teeth when it has food. Its rays will flow

to food, and allow it to taste it and enjoy its flavors. It

will have no need to chew it or cut it with the teeth.

Such being the case, all of the spirit is tongues; so, it

tastes successively and enjoys bliss increasingly without

feeling heavy, neither bored nor satisfied. Thus, its

enjoyment is always increasing without embittering by

anything, so its delight there will be greater than its

delight in this world, and will be completely different.

In this world, people soon satisfy their appetites,

whereas in the life to come nothing will restrict the spirit

from enjoying and taking continuous pleasure in

anything.

God says:

“This is a picture of the Garden which

the ones who see by God’s Light have been promised:

the rivers (of blessings) are running (underneath it):

eternal are its fruits, and so is its Shade (the Godly

Manifestation)...”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 13, Ar-

Ra’d (The Thunder), verse 35

As we mentioned before the spirits were confined to

the bodies in the worldly life therefore we see and feel

everything around us through the eyes, the ears, the nose,

the touch and the mouth, however the spirit feels, sees

and tastes not directly but behind a veil which is the body,

but in the Hereafter the case will be opposite that the

spirit will be out of its body surrounding it, thus the

believer's spirit becomes beautiful that it is overwhelmed

by the Godly light according to its good deeds and high

rank, as the beauty appears in its reality, it is the beauty

of the spirit itself not of that physical body, as the spirit

in Paradise becomes free from the obstructions of its

body which was confining it in the worldly life, so it

doesn’t become confined by time or place in the

Hereafter.

“

.

..

and their garments therein will be of silk”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 22, Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage), verse ﴿23﴾

When the human sleeps at night his spirit becomes

free from that lying body it goes or returns, loves or

hates, fears...speaks. While he is sleeping, he may see

himself in place then in another one without any link

between them even in time or place because his spirit is

free from the control of thought because the thought stops

working during sleeping, so he does not realize except

what his spirit sees and the place where it is.

In the Hereafter there is no need for thinking so it

will be disable, but the mind will remain since it is one of

the features of the spirit, as the spirit is the conscious

deathless essence of human so what it minds in the

worldly life of goodness or badness will be stained with

it forever.

Therefore, the spirit will be in one of two states, it

will be in a great happiness through what it has realized

and minded of this life and has a lightened face and has

continuous Divine lights with unlimited graces, or it will

be ashamed through its deeds therefore it will have a dark

face as it has a veil preventing him from witnessing the

Divine Right and the Godly favor, graces and Light, so

this disbeliever human being will be of a blind heart

because in the hereafter there are no materialistic

appearances but realities which can't be seen except

through the Godly Light.

The Almighty God says:

“And whose ever is blind in

this world, he will be blind in the hereafter and more

astray from the path”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿17﴾ Al-Isra' (The Night Journey), verse ﴿72﴾

However

all the creatures will return to their abstract spirits out of

the materials, away from their functions, the Almighty

God says:

“On the Day when the earth will be changed to

another earth and so will be the heavens, and they (all

the creations) will appear before Allah, The one, The

Irresistible”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 14, Ibrahim (Abraham), verse ﴿48﴾

In paradise

everything, such as those mentioned in the Holy Qur'an,

will differ from the things that we see in this life, it have

the same realities but it is more beautiful, pretty and

more sublime, no wonder if the human becomes blind in

the hereafter because he was blind-in sighted who

couldn’t see the realities through the Godly Light, his

spirit didn’t realize or mind any reality, but he saw the

images of things not more he couldn’t realize their

essence of realities, and in the hereafter all things will

return to its realities, therein he will not be able to see

them anymore because he wasn’t illuminated by a Godly

light in the worldly life and he was veiled by his

yearnings, the Almighty Al’lah says:

“...And he for whom

Allah has not appointed light, for him there is no light”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 24, An-Nur (Light), verse ﴿40﴾

This light would have guided

him in the worldly life if he had had it, but as he has lost

it, he is truly blind because he doesn't see in this life

except the enjoyments of his yearnings and adornment of

this secular life, and has not been guided by the company

of the Prophet (cpth):

“...Verily, it is not the eyes that

grow blind, but it is the hearts that are in the chests that

grow blind”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 22, Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage), verse ﴿46﴾

chapters.title: Lesson Fourteen
chapters.html:
The Thought Efficiency on Controlling the Spirit

A Real Story; the Psychological War

In this real story we will recognize the great benefit

that the believer gains from the thought, that precious gift

which the Almighty God has favored the human with...

Then how the psychological war gives affecting results

and gives its fruitiness.

Lack of Commitment Leads to Failure of the

Revolution

Officer Mohammed Amin Sheikho seemed to be

totally preoccupied with an extremely weighty matter.

His features were clouded by serious, deep

contemplation, while a look of intense truthfulness and

firm determination could be seen in his eyes.

His spirit was always fully absorbed in finding the

way to express a flood of great compassion and kindness.

So a few lines had appeared as furrows on his wide, pale

brow indicating the breadth of vision associated with his

lofty intentions that paid no heed to the passage of time

and its many events; equally they denoted the lines of the

future inscribed on the pages of history.

Hovering close by was a soldier waiting to speak to

the officer, but he hesitated to disturb him. He, too,

appeared to have a pressing problem on his mind and

stood there sighing from time to time. Eventually he

approached his commandant pleading, “Sir…Sir, please, I

want leave of absence”

Mohammad Amin snapped out of his reverie, “What? Leave of absence!” he thought. He could not

believe his ears! “You’re asking for leave as we’re about

to set off on a mission! Are you crazy? Get away from

me!”

The soldier left, wrapped in his own thoughts once

again. But it must be said that this soldier was extremely

fond of his commanding officer and trusted him

implicitly; he saw in him all the characteristics of

bravery, manhood and humanity, so he turned his horse

once again towards him and said: “Please, Sir! I beg you

to let me go now, and I will join you tomorrow. I know

the area where you will pitch camp… it is at the end of

Damascus Oasis, it is…” and he began to describe the

exact location to his commandant, then he continued: “So,

I promise you, sir, upon my honour that I will keep my

word”

“What are you saying? How can you ask for leave at

this time? Does this mean that you are a coward and

afraid to die? If I agree to your request it will be as if I’m

giving you permission to stay away from danger, to be

safe from dying, and if this gets to the ears of the high

command they will charge me with treason. And then

we’ll both be sentenced to death”

“Sir, I’m appealing to your leniency, and call for

your kindness and compassion to let me go. My wife is

now suffering the pains of childbirth and her delivery is

usually difficult; and as you know, Sir, I am a foreigner in

this country and have no family or friends here, so there

is nobody to help her except me”

“Soldier! I have told you, go away! Under the

circumstances no-one could possibly agree to such a

request”

The soldier turned away overcome with sadness, but

before long he turned back towards his officer yet again,

his source of refuge and support, but before he reached

him an idea had flashed into the mind of our officer,

Mohammad Amin, who was so overcome with happiness

at finding a solution that an immense feeling of gratitude

towards God seemed to shine from his eyes.

So, as the soldier approached him again, he winked

at him to put him at ease, and then both of them spurred

their horses and walked side by side away from the path

of the column of scouts and military personnel, so as to

be away from prying eyes.

“I have thought about your problem” our officer said

to the soldier, “and I really sympathise with you. I can

feel how anxious and confused you are, so I’ve decided to

give you an extended leave of absence. Go to your wife

because I’m sure she needs some help, and perhaps her

condition is dangerous for both her and the child; and do

not return to duty until I send for you. But you, in turn,

must do something for me”

Eager to comply with his officer’s wishes the soldier

said: “You have only to ask, Sir, whatever you want, and

you will find me at your service”

“In a little while we will reach the location which

will be our base from where we’ll conduct exploratory

forays. You know the area well, so I want you to…” and he

began to explain an idea he had in mind, while the soldier

listened attentively. When our officer finished talking the

soldier asked: “But sir! You haven’t told me what you

want me to do”

“I’ll tell you when I send for you”

The soldier thought that he wanted him to carry out a

personal favour, so our officer left him with this false

supposition and ordered him to rejoin his platoon.

The soldier spurred his horse and trotted away

happily, his eyes filled with tears of joy.

Our officer, Mohammad Amin, was a deputy

commander of the French advance reconnaissance

division, but if the high command had not been doubtful

of his loyalty they would have assigned him as its

commander. They were fully aware of his military genius

and abilities that astounded them and caused them to

admire him greatly; but, however, they could not forget

that he was the officer in charge of Anjar Castle when the

greatest arms deal between France and Greater Syria had

taken place. These armaments had been stored in the

castle and one night they were seized by the

revolutionaries. The French could not be sure about his

real role in that incident so they appointed him as an

adjutant, rather than the commander.

The French government decided that it could no

longer tolerate the revolutionaries’ skirmishes against its

forces which kept them constantly on the alert, therefore

they mounted this exploratory expedition of three

thousand heavily armed soldiers, planning to exterminate

all of the rebels once their locations and numbers had

been established.

All members of the public came to know about this

expedition, so a general air of gloominess and anxiety

pervaded throughout society. Then the leaders of the

revolution hurried as usual to their refuge, the Arab

officer, Mohammad Amin Sheikho. How often had they

reverted to him seeking his protection and found him,

indeed, their strongest and safest sanctuary; how often

had he endangered himself for their sake?

And yet every

time they went back on their word and let him face his

fate alone. Only Providence stood by him and saved him

in the nick of time so that potential failure turned into

unique success. But at this particular time, destruction

and death were hovering above them, so they promised

him faithfully and swore by God to measure up favorably

in the judgement of their Lord and his. So he did not

disappoint them:

“If God guides me to an appropriate solution I will

certainly use it, but I am not the commander of this

expedition, and the possibilities may be limited; so, put

all your trust in God”

The commanding officer of the reconnaissance

expedition looked at his adjutant in a way that conveyed

both trust and admiration. He knew of his expertise and

wisdom and of his superb abilities for planning which led

him to seek his advice on all military matters, and pin his

faith on his genius. So he gave no order without first

asking his adjutant’s advice. Therefore, when he saw that

our officer had left the column to walk alongside a

particular soldier he became concerned; yet it was not

long until he saw him coming back towards him.

Then, an

expression of sadness on his face, our officer spoke to

him in a loud voice so as to let other soldiers hear: “I am

very surprised and feel rather anxious. I moved away

from the column to explore the area and to question the

herders so as to assess the best approach for the coming

fight. I’ve been told that the rebels have come together

from everywhere: from

“

Aleppo, Idleb, Homs, Hama ﴿25﴾

, and

al-Arab Mountain ﴿26﴾

”

, and they are all marching towards

Damascus ﴿27﴾

.

They have called up a lot of supporters,

numbering some ten thousand so far and it’s growing all

the time. So, the information that the government has is

true and not just rumour. Indeed, I cannot understand how

they have sent us on this mission with such a small army.

As the ruling power fighting against a gang of

revolutionaries should be that we make a show of force

and have three times as many men as they have in order

not to lose face? Haven’t you noticed that the high

command has not sent even one French man with us! But

now talk is useless. We’re obliged to fight and win! In

fact it’s obvious that this expedition is not for

reconnaissance, as it’s supposed to be, but is for us to

engage in combat”

On hearing these words from his trusted adjutant the

commandant’s face turned pale and he was wide-eyed

with shock. The news circulated among the ranks as

rapidly as fire spreads through the dry stalks of a wheat

field, and fear began to creep into their hearts.

The expedition continued marching until they

reached the designated location. There, the soldiers

hurried to set up camp. They pitched the commandant’s

tent next to that of his adjutant after leaving a wide

passage between them that divided the camp into two

parts; then they put the arms in the middle standing on

end and leaning one against the other creating pyramid-

like shapes, so that the rifles could be quickly and easily

accessed by the men.

When our officer entered his tent, the commandant

hurried in behind him and asked: “What shall we do now?

What is the fighting-plan?”

“I’m tired now…in fact I feel exhausted, so I want to

sleep for a couple of hours at least and then we can make

plans. We are going to face a tough fight and we won’t be

able to sleep tonight as the rebels are close”

The commandant asked him in amazement: “Can you

really sleep in such dangerous circumstances?”

“

Yes, why not?” our officer replied and lay down on

his camp bed and closed his eyes.

The commandant looked at him, his eyes wide with

surprise, and then left the tent. He stood outside,

completely bemused, brought out a bottle of wine and

drank it to the last drop, then tossed the empty bottle

away in frustration. He began to ply the area outside

Mohammad Amin’s tent which made our officer feel a

certain optimism; clearly he had no intention of sleeping

but wanted to test the commandant’s reaction!

In the meantime, the soldier rode his horse slowly

away from the camp and headed towards the hill behind

which the camp was raised, and rode to the top; then he

quickly turned his horse and spurred it on to gallop at full

speed down the hill towards the camp.

The dust swirled and the horse neighed loudly then

the sound of its thundering hoofs soon came to the ears of

all the troops and their commander, and they sensed there

must be danger in the air!

They all stood motionless and stared at the rapidly

approaching rider who was waving his arms in the air, his

face and eyes filled with dread. He was shouting but his

words could not be understood.

As he passed through the passage between the tents

of the commander and the adjutant his thunderous voice

could be clearly heard and his terrible words fell on every

ear:

“We’ll be slayed, Arabs… we’ll be slayed, Arabs…

we’ll be slayed…!”

The wilds seemed to echo the desperation in his

voice, while he just kept on galloping, caring for nothing

else!

The expedition leader looked startled and his eyes

popped out, clearly showing the effects of the wine he had

drunk. He looked towards our officer, the man of the

moment, who rushed out of his tent and mounted his

horse, loosened the reins and let it race away.

The soldiers turned their eyes towards the

commandant and stared at him to see how he might react!

But since he had been overcome by dismay and wine, in

equal measure, he could think of nothing but saving his

own skin; so he ran towards his horse and, mounting it, he

spurred it into headlong flight. Silence and deadly alarm

prevailed over the soldiers who stood there, their eyes

wide with fear and terror!

What should they do?

Since the commandant and his adjutant had both fled

what could the soldiers do except turn tail and retreat?

Suddenly, turmoil spread among them so that they

seemed like a flock of sheep running away from the

attack of a lion! The entire force, soldiers and officers,

fled... caring for nothing but their own safety.

Indeed the soldier who had requested leave of

absence had now performed his part perfectly. He had

been motivated by the vivid mental picture of his wife in

labour and his concern that she might have difficulty

while giving birth with no-one to help her… afraid that if

he did not go to her he might lose her forever.

Now, let’s turn back to Officer Sheikho who

continued to spur his horse to go even faster, and little by

little, began to pull away from the line of the fleeing

troops until he was sure that they could not see him. Then

he turned his horse back heading once again towards the

camp. When he reached there, he rode about the camp and

found nothing but complete quiet and empty tents. He

looked at the dividing passage and saw the guns thrown to

the ground in complete disarray. The cowardly troops had

left everything behind and sought nothing but their own

safety.

He dismounted his horse and set about looking for

the field telephone; when he found it he cranked its

handle a few turns and then asked to be put through to the

high command. There and then, all other calls were

interrupted and cut off, for calls from the front always

had priority. Within moments the interpreter was on the

other end, translating every word to the French army

commander who said to our officer eagerly: “Tell me:

what is the news from you?”

“It is very bad” our officer replied, “we’re having a

hard time... there are more than ten thousand rebels

coming at us from every direction and the number is

increasing all the time, as if they’re pouring out of the

land. So we have fallen back in order to avoid the rebels

outflanking us so we could get out of this difficult

position with minimal loss”

“But how can you be there talking to me?” the French

commander asked.

“I have a racehorse…”

And immediately our officer cut the wire with a

sharp knife that he had ready for this purpose, leaving the

interpreter yelling: “Hello... hello...” at the end of a dead

line.

When the ‘defeated’ troops reached Damascus,

every one of them told a story about the event, his horror

and fear inspired by his own imagination. So they spoke

about unbearable events filled with unbelievable

violence. Besides, the majority of those men did not

report back to their barracks, for they were sure that the

occupying French would soon be driven out of the

country by the assault of the revolutionaries; so they

preferred to escape than to be killed.

This news was like a death blow for the French, for

the high command thought that a great number of troops

had been killed in the battle that, actually, did not take

place! So when General Sarrail ﴿28﴾

, the French resident in

Syria, looked into the reports and information which he

received, he was shocked and overwhelmed with

bitterness.

He found himself in a desperate situation that

filled him with terror, for he believed that in just one

battle most of his troops had been killed while the

revolutionaries were advancing in large numbers towards

Damascus, bent on victory. This was the summary of the

reports coming to him; therefore he believed that every

opening had been closed to him and felt as though day

had turned into night. He had not yet forgotten how the

revolutionaries had attacked Anjar Castle and seized the

weaponry and ammunition stored there which France had

shipped to its army in Syria.

At that moment, he turned to

his general staff, and burst out in a bitter and desperate

cry: “Pull out… pull out!”

All the French forces and their commanders

withdrew to Lebanon and left everything behind: the

barracks, the arsenals, the munitions, the bases, the

mounted cannons with their balls at the crossroads, and

guns scattered here and there.

They were happy to run away.

Even in Beirut General Sarai did not feel safe. He

feared that the forces of the resistance would reach there

to weaken French power and destroy them. Therefore he

preferred to make use of one of the warships which

patrolled the Mediterranean Sea and to wait on board to

watch the culmination of that horrible event.

Thus, Syria remained free of its occupiers and

enemies for three full days and nights, waiting for honest

Syrian men to seize the opportunity that Officer Sheikho

had presented to them; it was the suitable moment for

them to make the first move in order to shrug off the

mantle of shame, and eliminate injustice.

But alas! Slaves are not shackled by their chains, but

rather by their own subservience; their dubious intentions

soon became clear and their lack of conscience obvious to

everybody.

Is that not what you asked for?

Is that not what you wanted him to do?

Mohammad Amin accepted to go to fight alone with

the support of his Lord; so after this distinct victory you

had only to enter the empty barracks, take up the dust-

covered ordnance and take over the country!

Instead of that, the revolutionaries headed for the

stores and set about plundering them and killing each

other; and one of the dishonest leaders of the revolution

was killed while he was robbing a storekeeper in al-

Bzouriyah market at gunpoint.

For three full days and nights every camp remained

empty, with no-one present to offer any resistance; but

even so, not a single positive idea passed between the

leaders of the revolution, who surely, had failed to rise to

the cause.

In the meantime, the agents who were in the pay of

the French were following the situation, and informed

them that no-one had entered their camps or touched their

heavy armaments on the rebels behalf, and that the whole

affair had been like nothing more than a dense black

cloud that had passed without becoming a storm.

When General Sarai received the news he returned to

Syria with his army and vented his anger on Damascus;

he did not hesitate to show the depths of his inhumanity

and previously concealed bitterness and anger. He gave

orders for the heavy artillery to shell the al-Midan quarter

which was known as the refuge of the insurgents, so the

houses were destroyed and the flames rose high into the

sky, while rivers of blood flowed depriving children of

their parents, and parents of their children: reflecting a

picture of the most draconian barbarity.

chapters.title: Lesson Fifteen
chapters.html:
The Basic Rule of Attaining the Spiritual “Real

Inner” Happiness

We want to clarify in this important lesson why the

depravity originates followed by its resulted distress too,

which most of people consider as happiness although they

swallow its bitterness.

The human will be satisfied if he sees the individuals

of his society live the same level of life as he lives, until

he sees the others proceed him and have much luxuries,

welfares and terrestrial utilities more than he has.

For example, he still sees his house a beautiful one

unless he sees high palaces raised beside his house. He is

also still satisfied with its furniture and clothes until he

sees his neighbor gets new clothes or furniture which are

much better than his in quality and Excellency, the same

when he is satisfied with what he eats or drinks, the place

she visits, the transporting means he uses… etc. Until he

sees the life becomes changed to more luxury around

him, where he despises what he liked in the past, wherein

he will start having affliction and anxiety and become

world-weary.

I wonder, what was the cause behind that affliction

which is originated in this human spirit? And who’s the

responsible of its misery? Who does steal the satisfaction

and happiness which he was enjoying?

Aren’t they the luxurious people?! Who are the

reasons of corrupting the life of the rest of people of their

society? While this little group of luxurious enjoys

extremely their life, they corrupt the majority of people's

life.

Actually, most people couldn’t build a mansion or

palace, or even buy furniture suitable to it, even if they

could, although that is impossible to happen, you would

see the luxurious rich ones wouldn't stop at a certain

limit, but they would put all their efforts to create a new

life style in order to be distinct in their society!

Indeed the competition still remains, it’s not just to

have a deluxe life but it’s to brag, to showing off and to

boasting before others:

“Know that the life of this world is only play and

amusement, pomp and mutual boasting among you, and

rivalry in respect of wealth and children, as the likeness

of vegetation after rain, thereof it dries up and you see it

turning yellow, then it becomes straw. But in the

Hereafter a sever torment and forgiveness from Allah

and His good Pleasure, whereas the life of this world is

only a deceiving enjoyment”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 57, Al-Hadid (Iron), verse ﴿20﴾

Therefore the rivalry in getting luxury means

boasting through wealth, this rivalry hasn’t an end,

because the spirit will not still enjoy its pleasure and will

not be satisfied with something it has for a long time, but

it always requests another new pleasing thing, as well

whenever it has a desire of its, it will ask for another one

… and for more… without an end, wherein the life will

pass off and end but its yearning and desires never end.

The Almighty Al’lah says:

“The mutual rivalry for piling up of worldly things

diverts you. Until you visit the graves”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress 102, At-

Takathur (Rivalry in World Increase), verse (1-2)

Because the spirit has unlimited power, where it can

absorb all the pleasure of the world without getting

satisfied and without satiating its limitless capabilities,

thus the Almighty God has prepared it with such

unlimited capability, that is to be able to absorb a part of

His Beauty, Mercy, Knowledge and Potency and to be

filled the Divine sublime source.

In the Divine speech:

“My earth and My heavens didn’t receive Me, but

the heart of the believer human did”

Alternatively, if the human obeyed himself by

responding to all his worldly yearning, he would fail to

attain the real pleasure, furthermore he would offer

himself more distress, misery and affliction while he

thought it’s the reason behind his happiness, but in fact it

increases his affliction.

Throughout that competition in getting luxuries of

life, the life becomes full of complication and difficulties

instead of ease, and distress instead of happiness, as our

state nowadays.

This complication will affect negatively

on spirits where it will suffer the distress and turn into

unhappiness, it will also lose the simple kind nature that

the Almighty God created in it, and the reason behind all

that is the luxurious people who corrupt the life of the

others through their luxury and enjoyments, therefore the

consciences and the morals will be corrupted too, as all

the people concern will deviate to collecting money

wherever it is from, that is to accomplish all their desires

and yearning, and trying to be imitators of those who are

wealthier than them or to boast before others corrupting

their life and hearts.

Actually, the civilization with all its complications

has brought misery and affliction to people, and

generated the pain and malice in their spirits where on

one hand it has brought and spread the trouble and

hostility among the wealthy people themselves and on the

other hand between them and the needy ones, wherein the

rich people multiply their wealth, exploiting and

controlling others, but the deprived poor increase in level

of neediness.

No wonder that the needy will hate the luxurious

rich, and desire to make them suffer the same misery,

either those needy who become rich will have the same

thinking after a while, because it’s the same purpose that

made him fight to be rich, moreover the demands of the

civilization increases wherein the human becomes churl

toward himself and the others too, and doesn’t make any

goodness but very little. Without the good deeds the

society will be separated and will lose the love which

must be prevailing among its individuals.

God’s Regulation Is the Effective Salvation from the

Social Crises and the Way of Attaining Happiness:

Whatever the crises are, spiritual or moral, in every

society, they will not be solved without destroying their

roots ‘causes’, that means to return to the Almighty God

regulation ‘constitution’ and submit to His order because

it’s the only law that will save us from the distress in both

lives.

That deed saved previously the Noble companions

and followers of the holy Prophet, therefore the Almighty

God warned the human not to exploit all his efforts to

attain the worldly pleasure and not to plunge in it where

we will lose the hereafter, but we must walk by its sides,

because as we notice nowadays the corruption on the

earth surface (in the nations), wherein if man is

corrupted, his disadvantages will increase and he will not

have any benefit, thus the corruption resulted from this

luxurious civilization strikes the people life and their

morals, moreover it depraves the path of our eternal

happiness or even it covers God’s purpose of our

existence,

The technological revolution is the frustration of

humanity in our times; it turns people away from true happiness

which cannot be compared with its false and sensory reflection. It

frustrates because the latter is not in fact happiness; rather it is

merely the amusement of the self in base pleasures and passing

desires. What a difference there is between that and true

happiness! The spirit's yearnings are many, and its

capability is unlimited; in contrast, our bodily capability

is restricted. The difference between these two powers is

the cause of pain and wretchedness; joining an unlimited

power to a limited one makes the latter unable to fulfill

the wishes of the former.

The spirit is like an unruly

horse; whenever it fulfills a desire, it tirelessly seeks

another, because the nature of its construction is

immaterial. The Almighty did not create unbounded

power so that it would be filled with dirt. Rather it was

created to be filled with absolute beauty that might drink

from the inexhaustible spring of perfection.

How different these two states are! In one, false

pleasures —which are to be terminated before the spirit

leaves this life— resulted in boredom and weariness

mixed with distress, grief and pain. On the other hand, the

spirit experiences a lasting and growing happiness from

which it can never be separated. In the life to come, there

is nothing but truth: falsehood ceases to exist. Therefore,

the spirits of those who turn away from Al’lah in the

present life come before their Creator in a state of

blindness on the Day of Resurrection. This is the result of

being too absorbed in gratifying the desires of the lower

life, and neglecting to discern what is right before its end.

God says:

“Those who give no heed to My

Reminder shall live in woe and come before Us in

blindness on the Day of Resurrection. ‘Provider!’ they

will say: ‘why have You brought us blind before You

when in our lifetimes we were blessed with sight?’ He

will answer: ‘so were you,’

…”: you were blind hearted

in the worldly life

.“…‘Our Revelations were declared

to you and you forgot them; would you be forgotten

this day?’”

: shall We forget you today? It is necessary to

force your spirit to accept the cure for its sickness.

The

Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 20, Ta Ha (Ta-Ha = Pure), verses

124-126

This fact is supported by the Almighty’s

Saying

: “…Verily, it is not the eyes that grow blind, but

it is the hearts (spirits) which are in the chests that

grow blind…”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 22, Al-Hajj (The

Pilgrimage), verse 46

And the Holy Saying:

“He who has been blind in

this life will be blind in the life to come and go further

astray”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 17, Al-Isra’ (The

Night Journey), verse 72

chapters.title: Lesson Sixteen
chapters.html:
The Way of Attaining the True Belief in the

Almighty God

We have clarified shortly the way of belief in the Almighty

God through the first lessons of the pre-material world “al-Azal

world”, but now it’s time to talk about the most important thing

which changes the human if he sincerely attains it and brings him

nearer to the Almighty God.

It is the true belief and faith, but to attain the true

belief in the Almighty God you have to go along with a

precise system and proceed its procedures, but what are

these procedures?

Way of Belief and True Faith

This universe contains the sun and the moon, the

planets and stars, rain and ice, clouds and winds, animals

and plants, the heavens and even the earth in its circular

orbit, the four seasons with their changes and successions,

and night and day with their differences and alternation.

That is to say, the universe contains this multitudinous

world filled with all its creatures and beings. This

includes your body, composed of its systems and organs,

and the commutation, dissolution and composition that

happen inside it. Its glands perform the necessary

secretions and the body prepares the different substances

it requires. The universe is filled with everything that you

know and everything that you do not know, and runs

according to firm rules and strict discipline.

Therefore, if the Great Creator has laid down a law

for this universe with all its creatures, and a system to be

followed and

not to be broken, and if this Great Creator has taken

that same

universe and subjugated it for humans, is it then

possible or believable that human beings, the noblest of

all creatures, have

no law or statute to follow? Has the Great Creator

arranged the

entire universe, only to leave humankind to live in

this life without guidance or order? Has the Great Creator

put this entire universe in order, and then neglected

humanity and let them astray in the darkness, unable to

distinguish between that which benefits them and that

which hurts them, not knowing how to proceed through

the unknown of this life? It is undoubtedly true that right

thought, sound logic, and sane understanding decree and

confess the existence of a law which has been planned for

humankind. The question, then, is: where is that law and

order?

Let us consider what all the noble Envoys brought

from God.

Let us listen to the first verses with which the

Almighty Al’lah inspired the Envoy (cpth), so that he (cpth) could

inform people. God says:

“Read in the Name of your

Provider who has created, He has created man from a clot!, Read, and Your

Provider is the Noblest One, Who has taught by printing (

referring to the instincts and the yearnings

which God created in the spirits of humanity),

He has taught man what he did not know.”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 96,

Al-’Alaq (The Clot), verses 1-5

Let us think deeply about these words which the

Envoy (cpth) disseminated to all the Arabs and all the

nations. Let us meditate on that sign to which the Envoy

(cpth) led his noble companions, and let us study the

Qur'an verses sent from Al’lah which he (cpth) recited to

the people in Mecca in the first days of his mission. Let

us look as the one who is thirsty for truth looks, rather

than as the one who is clinging to what their forefathers

followed, without perception or thinking. Let us leave

behind the ignorance which has been fabricated by some

people through whims and misguidedness.

Let us return to righteousness, for it is only

righteousness that should be followed. Let us be guided

by the noble Envoys and adopt the straight path that they

all adopted before us. When you do that, you will

discover the required order and the law that is decided for

humanity in the Qur'an. It was this same law which the

Envoy (cpth) himself applied, and which he called all his

noble companions to apply. In this way they achieved

high rank, and became known all over the world. This was

how they gained the happiness and boons they gained. I

say, to apply this law and order is to consider your origin

and to think of your beginning, because those who

recognize themselves will recognize their Provider. When

they recognize their Provider, He will guide them to the

way of happiness and protect them from misery and loss.

Therefore, those whom God guides are the ones who have

adopted the straight path, but those who go astray from

God will find no other lord than Him. Oh! Think of your

origin, for thinking of your origin and your beginning is

the first article of this law and order which Al’lah has

legislated for you.

Think! Why do you not think, since your Provider

has granted you such a precious jewel to help you in

thinking, to lead you to know your Creator and Provider?

Think! Why do you not think, when He has given you the

great signs and the amazing discipline of this universe,

with wide fields and large scope, in which your thought

can be absorbed and roam? Think! Why do you not think,

since the universe is an open book before you? You can

read even if here is no teacher to teach you or no one to

tend to you, because Almighty Al’lah is the best Teacher

and Guide for you, as long as you are truthful.

Think of

your origin when you were semen in your father's back.

Consider this semen: how was it formed? Of what is it

composed? Consider this semen: where was it put, and

where did it settle? Think of yourself when you were in

that safe haven, the deep darkness of the womb. Think of

those stages through which you have passed: from semen

to a clot, from a clot to a lump of flesh, from a lump of

flesh to bones. Consider how these bones have been

arranged in good order and consistency.

The muscles have been fixed upon the bones, and

from them have been made holes for the brain, the eyes,

the ears and the mouth, a cavity for the heart and one for

the lungs, and vessels for the intestines, and centres for

the veins and for the sinews. Think! I do not want to

develop this in great detail. I shall let you witness and see

how semen, made from an extract of different fruits, has

turned into a balanced human being and a noble creature.

Think of and appreciate the greatness of the Hand

which created and formed you. It made these organs for

you, creating the brain, the heart, the main systems of the

body, their bone structure, and all of the different

components, and placed them in a safe place and a

protected fort. Think of that Hand which nourished you

when you were just coming into this world, alone and

without any power or strength.

You were unable to

provide yourself with anything, and indeed, nobody could

provide you except the Hand which watched over your

creation. It is that Hand which provided you, delivering

food to you and supplying each of your organs with its

necessary subsistence.

Think of that Hand, which was able to turn you from

semen into a perfect person within just a few months, so

that Its creation would neither be delayed nor premature

in forming a human being within the appointed term.

Then, when the time of birth and entry into this

world approached, It turned you upside down in your

mother’s belly, placing your head facedown and your legs

upwards, thus paving the way for your birth. God says:

“Man has been killed. What makes him disbelieve?

From what thing has He created him? From semen He

has created and estimated him, then He paved the way

for him, then He let him die and entombed him, then, if

he will, He brings him to life. Is not it so? He (man) has

not yet applied what He (Al’lah) has ordained for him”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 80, ‘Abasa (He Frowned!),

verses 17-23

Having come into this new world and this new land,

think how He endowed you with your mother’s sympathy

and kindness, and put love and tenderness for you in her

heart. He prepared your food in her breasts and made it

pleasant, luscious and nourishing to drink, containing all

the subsistence needed and required by your body.

Think of those meals and aliments which that

Merciful Handmade for you. It increased their nutritional

proportions moment by moment and meal after meal, in a

way that was appropriate to your growth and your

advances in years. Then, when your body required more

nourishment and your stomach became able to digest

solid foods, He raised your milk teeth, one tooth after

another, according to what was required by growth and

necessity.

After this, when you were seven years old, in order to

build a body that would be ready for serious situations

and great deeds, and to create a mind that could manage

heavy affairs, Here placed your milk teeth with standard

ones to process the food that would be necessary for this

human body.

Think of that Hand which is still providing you up

until now. It sends the hot sunrays into the sea in order to

vaporize the water. It then moves the winds to drive the

clouds and rouse them from their lurking places,

gathering them and piling them up in masses through

which drops of water pour down, expressing God’s

cordiality towards His creatures.

Once the dead earth is revived and irrigated after its

thirst, It drives away the clouds and reveals the clear sky and

the shining sun.

This allows the plants to begin their growth, and it is

then that the land grants lavish blessings. God says:

“Have you considered the fact that you cultivate? Is it

you that give it growth, or We? If We pleased, We could

turn it into chaff. Would you then keep amusing

yourselves or would you say: We have incurred a loss.

Indeed, we have deprived ourselves? Have you

considered the water which you drink? Was it you that

poured it from the clouds, or We? If We pleased, We

could turn it saline; will you then give thanks?”

The

Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 65, Al-Waqi’a (The Inevitable

Event), verses 63-70

Consider the foods and their various kinds, and the

flowers and their forms and smells, and the varieties of

fruit and their colors and tastes. Consider the four seasons

and their alternation. Consider sleep and how God the

Almighty has made it a period of cessation of feeling.

Consider the day and how He made it a means of

subsistence. Think of the air which helps you to breathe

and inhale, and which provides the oxygen needed for

burning materials. Think of the sun which supplies you

with heat and light. Think of the seas and rivers, plains

and mountains, animals and plants, clothes and covering,

wool, cotton and flax. Think of this Hand, which fulfills

all your requirements and keeps rearing you, showering

you with its blessing, overwhelming you with its favor,

and supplying you with provision, one moment after

another without any cessation.

Think in this way and think of this Providence, for it

was through such thought and reflection that our master

Abraham took his first step in the way of belief. Through

such thinking, our master Adam (pth) and our master

Mohammad (cpth) and all the noble Envoys who came

through the ages started on their path to belief.

Think! If you did, you would be guided and would

know that there is a Great Provider who looks after you

and never neglects you even for a twinkle of an eye. This

Provider continued to provide you from the time that you

were an embryo until you became an infant, a young

child, and then a complete human being. Therefore His

Sustenance to you is permanent, and His Charity keeps

successively flowing over you. If these things settle

inside your spirit so that they have fully entered into your

mind and you have ascertained their reality, a new field

and a different way of thinking will open before you.

If this were to happen, you would see that your body

will not remain either strong or fortitudinous, and that

you will not live forever. Thus it was for your relatives

who have left this life and passed away. So is it with your

neighbor, who has parted from spouse and children and

met death, after enjoying the worldly life for only a few

years. Furthermore, your friends were not able to take

pleasure in their stores or in the houses which they built.

Death killed all their hopes in this life, and so they

died at their appointed times without delay. There are

those who have died after sickness, others after trouble,

and others suddenly and unexpectedly. You remember

this one and that one, the king sand princes, the supreme

commanders, the rich and the poor, and even the noble

Envoys, and you find that death has left none of them

untouched. Then you will be sure that death is your

inevitable end, despite all efforts, just as it was the end of

those who came before you. There is no escape and no

way to get away from it.

At that time, you will find no

hope in this life and you will know that it is no more than

a temporary world. Thinking of death produces fear and

awe in your spirit, and generates a serious desire to attain

knowledge of the Provider, making you truly rush to seek

Him. You ask yourself Who this Provider is, Who created

you from semen

—though you were nothing worth

mentioning before this—

and then made you into a child

and then a perfect person.

You contemplate the universe

once again, but you look deeper than before. There you

will find that It is this Provider Who steers the sun and

the moon and directs all of the universe and all of its

contents in order to provide you and to fulfill all your

demands and meet all your needs. There is no hand and

no act of anyone besides Him. He alone is Al’lah, apart

from whom there is no god.

Hence, you will move from believing in the Provider

to new level, which is belief in this Provider as the

Steering God. You will see the heavenly bodies

swimming within their orbits, and witness the sun

sending down its rays and heat. Moreover, you will see

the clouds moving, stirred from their hidden sites, and the

winds running violently according to their directions. You

will see the waters of the large seas scrambling and their

waves chopping, the rivers flowing down from their

sources, running to their mouths where they enter the

seas.

As for the terrestrial globe, you will see it

swimming within its space and its orbit, circulating

around itself, along with all the creatures it carries on its

surface. You will see all of this moving, but only through

God’s Power and Command. You will think more and

more deeply until you realize that no creature can take a

single step or raise a hand or move a single inch except

by God’s Leave, Will, and Power.

Thence you will advance in thinking, rising and

ascending until you reach a degree of understanding

where you witness that the whole universe is but a single

unit of connected parts and bonded atoms. Furthermore,

you will recognize that it all works in harmony and

uniformity, and that the Godly Will watches over it and

supports it. Thus, the Provider is the Steering God of the

whole universe, and there is no director or god other than

He.

You will know that your Provider is Al’lah, and

therefore, having witnessed this in the universe with your

spirit and ascertained it in your own depths, you will say

with your tongue that there is no god but Al’lah. You will

utter it with your tongue because it is lodged in your

mind; you will not be dependent on imitation or what you

have heard from others. Your belief in this will be akin to

the belief of the goodly ancestors and the noble

companions rather than the belief of old men, which is

based on legends and illusions. Thus, you will attain true

belief in this statement and will actually say: “There is no

god except Al’lah”. That is some of what we understand

of God’s Saying:

“Know that there is no god but

Al’lah…”

The Holy Qur'an,

Fortress 47, Muhammad

(Muhammad), verse 19

In the noble saying, the Envoy (cpth) says:

“He who

says: There is no god but Al’lah, faithfully and loyally,

will enter Paradise. It was said: What is the sign of its

loyalty? He said: To keep him away from what is

forbidden by Al’lah” ﴿29﴾

Surely, this will prevent anyone from committing the

deeds forbidden by God, because they will see that Al’lah

the Almighty is with them, watching and observing them

wherever they turn and whatever they do.
