chapters.title: Lesson Seventeen
chapters.html:
The Way of Belief in the Almighty God and

His Noble Envoy (cpth)

Having arrived at this stage —the belief that there is

no god but Al’lah, and the belief in the Provider— I will

advance quickly, since you are now able to accompany

me without delay. I now want to reveal to you the effects

of the belief that there is no god but Al’lah, and to lead

you to the love of the Envoy of God (cpth). Therefore, I

say that when you believe that there is no god but Al’lah

you become one of those who sees that God’s Hand

controls the movement of the universe.

When your spirit

is immersed in this view you will witness that no winds

blow, no clouds cover the sky or stick together, no rains

flow, no lightning flashes or shimmers, no thunder

resounds, no sea runs high or low with restless waves, no

river water flows in constant flux, no volcano breaks out

angrily, no flood streams forth with force or intensity, no

earthquake shakes the land and makes forgetful and

heedless hearts tremble in fear, no earth rotates, causing

night and day and the four seasons, no stars swim shining

within the system of their orbits, except as directed by the

Hand of the Wise and Peerless One.

That is to say,

according to your efforts and your daily contemplations,

you will witness that the universe —with all its

creatures— is but one unit steered by the Will of the

Cognizant and Omniscient One.

What is more, without

Him your hand does not move, your eye does not blink,

your ear does not hear a sound or a noise, your heart does

not beat its pulses between systole and diastole, your

stomach does not secrete its gastric juice over the foods

inside it, your liver does not store substances or secrete

others according to its firm standards, your lungs do not

expand and contract between inhalation and expiration,

your blood does not flow in arteries and veins, the red

corpuscles do not carry what they carry to and fro, the

white corpuscles do not fight and struggle with microbes,

and germs do not severely attack the body.

Furthermore, I

say that if you become sure of all this by way of thought

and spiritual witnessing, rather than by listening to

specialists or reading volumes and books, you will see

that everything is controlled by God’s Hand and that all

people, be they notables or commoners, be they near or

far, be they strong or weak, and even all of the creatures

of the earth, none of these can render you any benefit,

nor protect you from any evil, nor hurt you, nor cause any

change in your situation, except by Al’lah’s Leave.

Thus

you will enter the fort of straightness, and you will never

exceed God’s bounds. Since the spirit cannot remain

motionless, you will find that once it has forsaken

misdeeds and turned wholly towards Al’lah, it will spare

no effort in doing charity and favor. It will become

engaged in helping everyone in need, because it will wish

to approach Al’lah by means of this activity.

At this stage —the stage of straightness upon God’s

Order and approaching Him by doing favor— the spirit

will be confident of its charity and of God’s Satisfaction

with it. As a result of such confidence, it will draw nearer

to its Creator and turn wholly towards Him, so that a link

will be established. Then its communication with God

will be correct. It will see that it lives in a state of

proximity rather than distance, feeling love and purity

rather than coolness or disinclination.

It will consequently

enjoy a happy life of repose and bliss. At this time, the

spirit will gain two fruits that it would never have gained

without this link to the Creator and the entrance into His

Presence, and it will gain them only by virtue of this link,

this direction, and this pleasant communication with God.

The first fruit is that

—by turning towards its

Creator— all sins will fall away from the spirit, with the

word ‘sins’ here referring to the mean desires that are

attached to the spirit and the defects that are rooted in it.

Thus, by communicating with God, these lowly yearnings

will be eroded, dropping away so that the spirit will be

pure of disease. It will emerge from this communication

having acquired purification and cleanliness; it will be

free of the lust that once disturbed it and the dirt that once

befouled it.

There will be no stinginess, no cowardice, no

attachment to this worldly life, no miserliness, no

rudeness, no grossness, no hard-heartedness, no desire to

do damage, no cowering, no subservience, no inclination

to oppression or aggression, and no wish for worldly

glory or authority.

Thus, there will be none of the bad

qualities that degrade humanity’s esteem or standing

among people or with God.

All of these negative qualities

will be wiped out by the link with Al’lah and the entrance

into His Presence. The Envoy (cpth) explained the effect

that communication with God has on the spirit of

humanity in a noble saying, where he (cpth) says:

“Suppose there is a river flowing beside the doorway of

one of you, and that this person washes himself there,

five times a day. What do you say about this? Will any of

his dirt remain? They said that no dirt would remain.

He told them that this example explains the five prayers.

Al’lah effaces misdeeds through them” ﴿30﴾

That is the first fruit that results from entering into

God’s

Presence and performing the correct

communication.

As for the second fruit

, here it is explained, and

how delighted you will be if you get it! When your spirit

attains the link with your Creator, you will feel life

flowing in its depths, just as one feels the reviving

warmth of the sun in days of bitter coldness. You will feel

life spreading in your spirit, as one feels a breeze of fresh

and gentle air while sitting in the shadow of a tree on a

midsummer’s day. You will feel life entering your spirit,

just as a thirsty person feels cool water flowing into their

body, quenching their thirst and refreshing their body and

soul. You will feel so much, and there is no feeling of the

believer more beautiful than what they feel in the times

of their closeness to their Creator and Provider.

Moreover, while you are absorbed in this state of

lofty and sublime feeling, high impressions of perfection

will be imprinted on the surface of your spirit. That is the

second fruit that the spirit gains through true

communication and nearness to

Al’lah

. This perfection,

which colors the spirit at the time of its entrance into

God’s

Presence, will be manifested in the spirit of the

believer in the form of mercy, tenderness, generosity,

bounty, chivalry, helping the needy, telling the truth,

openness of speech, kindness, gentleness, politeness,

patience, deliberateness, modesty, bravery, justice,

equity, self-esteem, a sense of honor, resistance to

falseness, and so forth. Whatever attributes and

indications of perfection you may mention, you will find

that the spirit acquires them and is colored by them when

it is near to

Al’lah

, for God says:

“It is the stain of

Al’lah

. And who gives a better stain than

Al’lah

? And

we are worshiping Him.”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress 2, Al-Baqara (The Cow),

verse 138

When the spirit reaches such a stage and ascends to

such a rank through its perfection and high manners, you

will find that it loves all people of perfection and high

merit. It will love every perfect person because of the

perfection it has achieved itself, for none appreciates a

favor except those who possess it, and only people of

perfection can know perfection. In this way, if the spirit

sees people of generosity and bounty, it appreciates their

advances over itself in generosity and bounty, and if it

meets people of compassion and affection, it esteems

their superiority over itself in compassion and affection.

So it is with all the other supreme qualities and morals.

The spirit will appreciate any who surpasses and exceeds

it. Therefore it will love perfect believers when it finds

them, and if it meets truthful leaders it will adore them

and accompany them.

The Envoy of God (cpth) is the

master of the people of perfection, and supersedes all the

worlds in this domain. Moreover, because of his

closeness to his Creator, he (cpth) attained the greatest

share of perfection from that Godly Presence, so that no

angel or human could approach his rank. Consequently,

you will find that a believer reveres

God’s

Envoy (cpth)

whole-heartedly. In the view of a believer, there is no

creature greater than the Envoy, and nobody has a rank

loftier than his (cpth).

When believers hear something

about him (cpth), their hearts long for him; if his name or

his merits or his deeds are mentioned, their spirits travel

over large distances and set aside the eras and generations

that separate them, arriving to join and accompany that

venerable spirit, maintaining a firm link with it that never

breaks or sunders.

By way of this spiritual flowing, and through this

moral connection, in the company of that spirit

-

that is,

the pure and virtuous spirit of the Envoy (cpth)

-

and by

becoming one of those who reach such a level, your spirit

will ascend gently and without feeling in the company of

the Envoy’s spirit, which is always entering into

Al’lah

.

Thus your spirit will be together with that of the Envoy

(cpth) in

God’s

Presence. At that moment, the light of the

Envoy (cpth)

—whom Almighty

Al’lah

has called

“

the

shining lamp

”

—

will illuminate an aspect of

God’s

Perfection for you. This will allow you to witness what

you deserve of

God’s

Compassion, Tenderness,

Sympathy, Kindness, Clemency, Charity, Justice, Might,

Knowledge, Wisdom, abundant Favor, Provision,

comprehensive Steering, Boons for every being that has

life and a soul, and all the other Godly Attributes, which

no one can witness without becoming infatuated with

them and adoring them.

Out of its passion and love for the Godly Perfection

that arises from seeing the Supreme Attributes, the spirit

attains a high link with its Creator. This link is achieved

through the love that is produced when one witnesses the

Godly Attributes and Perfection. Furthermore, through

this link the spirit will acquire a light from

Al’lah

the

Almighty that allows it to see goodness, and understand

that it really is good. Consequently, the spirit likes and

inclines towards this goodness. Similarly, the spirit

comes to see evil and understand that it really is evil, and

so it disdains and loathes this evil. By my life, this is the

piety (seeing by

Al’lah’s

Light) to which the Almighty

Al’lah

urged His believing worshipers, and with which He

charged them.

“You, who (certainly) believe! See by

Al’lah’s

Light, and be with the truthful.”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress 9, At-Tawba (Repentance), verse 119

God says:

“You who believe; see by

Al’lah’s

Light

and believe in His Envoy. He will grant you two portions

of His Compassion and make a light for you by which

you can go, and forgive you:

Al’lah

is Forgiving and

Merciful.”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress 57, Al-Hadid (Iron), verse 28

In another Fortress He says:

“You who believe; if

you become illuminated by

Al’lah’s

Light, He will grant

you discernment and cleanse you of your sins and

forgive

you.

Al’lah

is of great bounty

”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress 8, Al-Anfal (Spoils of War),

verse 29

He also says:

“You who believe; see by

Al’lah’s

Light and speak opposite speech. He will make your

works right and forgive you your sins. Those who obey

Al’lah

and His

Envoy shall win a great victory

”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress 33, Al-Ahzab (The

Combined Clans), verses 70-71

Undoubtedly, that is piety in its reality. In Arabic,

the word

‘

piety’ means ‘avoidance.’ Therefore we can

understand that 'piety’ means avoiding evil through

Al’lah’s

Light. This is the avoidance of danger, having

witnessed the causes of corruption in this worldly life by

means of the Godly Light

,

the Light which you would

never have gained access to, if your spirit had not been

connected with that of the Envoy (cpth).

Thus belief in the Envoy (cpth) comes after belief in

God, and loving the Envoy (cpth) is always joined with

the right faith and associated with true communication

with God. The noble saying denotes:

“

He that has no

love has no faith. He that has no love has no faith. He

that has no love has no faith.”

Indeed, the favor of the

Envoy is so limitless that none can express it

.

ighteen

An Entire County

I

A

R

eal

tory)

The head of a military division trusts his

commanding officer according to the belief and

confidence he has in the man’s abilities: his cleverness

and wisdom; courage and resourcefulness; sound military

planning; and the successful outcomes of his timely

guidance.

When the head of a division goes to war with his

troops, he maintains contact with his commander,

especially in the heart of a battle when the scale of the

war escalates and comes to a head, and when there is little

or no further opportunity to change tactics or manoeuvre

and he senses the actual danger surrounding the division.

He can take no unilateral action so he holds the battle line

and communicates with his commander via field

telephone to inform him of the details of the situation and

give further orders to be fulfilled at once.

Through effective communication, having

considered all available information, and influenced by

his own previous experience, the commanding officer

guides him to a plan which he acts without delay; the

outcome will then be successful, for rather than being

faced with a potentially devastating defeat it can become

a landslide victory. All of this is achieved by virtue of his

contacting his commanding officer when the division is

in a very tight corner, exactly as the

The Arab commandant

"

Qutayba ibn Muslim

"

communicated with his commander-in-chief, Al-Hajjaj

Ibn Yusuf Al-Thaqafi, when he had failed to conquer

Bukhara, the heavily-fortified city. The commander then

sent him a plan of action and he went on to conquer the

city without further delay.

The examples above illustrate that if man attains true

communication with God (which

Al’lah

wishes from all

men, for their own benefit), and if he reaches this state of

communication by witnessing scenes of

Al’lah’s

Attributes, that is, His Mercy, Sympathy, Kindness,

Justice, Charity and Beauty, he would then experience

real love of Him, the Almighty, since a man’s spirit is

naturally disposed towards the love of perfection.

Through this communication

Al’lah

supplies him with the

water of real life which he finds compelling, and so his

prayer will keep him away from committing indecent and

shameful deeds.

God says:

“If only they had remained on the right

path, We would certainly have supplied them with

water in abundance, so that We might enthrall them

by it. But if anyone turns away from thoughts of his

Provider, He will cause him to undergo severe

punishment.”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿72﴾ , Al-Jinn (The Jinn), verses 16-17

His heart will be filled with light through this

communication by which he is able to distinguish good

from evil and truth from deceit. So long as he

communicates with God, turns

honestly towards Him and

performs the prayer by which he communicates with none

but Him, this Godly Light will persist for him: it will

illuminate the right path and enable him to discriminate

between good and evil, for the Almighty says:

“O you

that believe! Be under

Al’lah’s

Light and believe in

His Envoy and He will bestow on you a double portion

of His Mercy and provide you with a Light by which

you will walk on the right path.

..

”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿57﴾ Al-Hadid (The Iron), verses 28

The true believer asks for his

Provider’s

Guidance in

all his affairs and asks to be shown the right way in every

matter.

The Holy Hadith states

: “The one who is obedient to Me

draws ever closer to Me by performing good deeds of his own

free will until I love him. If I love him I shall be his ears by

which he hears, and his eyes by which he sees” ﴿31﴾

When man follows

Al’lah’s

Words

the Holy

Qur'an

in every matter, he will walk in safety and

tranquillity throughout this earthly life; and when he

allows

Al’lah’s

Light to be the lamp which illuminates

the way he will lead a life full of happiness and peace.

The Prophet

cpth

formed most of his battle plans

whilst praying to

Al’lah

, as did his noble companions

who came after him.

Al’lah

revealed the plans to him and

by executing them glorious victory was achieved with the

least number of casualties on both sides, for he

cpth

is

the Envoy of mercy to all the worlds.

And here we shall recount an event that took place

with our merciful scholar in one of the villages of

Damascus,

and which proves to us the truth of

his words

for

“the

scholars are the

successors of the Prophets.” ﴿32﴾

***

The fires of the Great Syrian Revolution erupted in

Syria and soon permeated throughout the entire territory

like a powerful, uncontrollable flood, for there remained

no city or village that failed to join in support of the

revolution. Fighting was flaring up everywhere, and

adding fuel to the fire was that the French government

had been informed by its spies that a particular area of

Syria

had become an added burden for French forces in

the country because it was a major centre of rebellion,

and provided shelter for the insurgents. It supplied them

with provisions and the necessary support and assistance

to fulfil their revolutionary plans of destroying French

interests in Syria. Added to this, most of the men of the

area joined the rebels’ lines so, undeniably, they were

with them, body and soul.

The reports escalated and the French government

grew ever more angry and frustrated until the situation

finally came to a head. When he could no longer contain

his frustration and fury the French High Commissioner

decided to show his fangs and relieve his mind of the

problems of this county which his spies had convinced

him was a hot-bed of revolutionary movements

undermining the security of France. If the truth be known

this rebellion was, in fact, a cry from the depths of the

Syrian soul against the violent injustice of French

occupation.

Eventually his reaction was explosive:

“

Shell the

entire territory…

destroy it!

”

“

Equip a division of the army with heavy-armaments

and bomb it from end t

o end…

show no mercy for there

can be no mercy in war… torture the people…

every last

one of them is our enemy…

let

even the innocent die…

let

the children be burned

...

let the women and old men be

killed…

I d

o not care who suffers or dies…

I just want this

cursed uprising suppressed

”

The terrible news reached the people and the leaders

of the insurgency, by way of certain loyal patriots who

seemed, outwardly, to support France. It fell on their ears

like a violent thunderclap and their hearts fluttered in

terror as they foresaw the destruction of their entire

district before their very eyes: houses burned to the

ground

...

the innocent become vagrants wandering the

streets

...

children killed

…

women and old men

slaughtered

...

in fact, similar to what had happened

previously to al-Mleha village near Damascus

...

for no-

one had been spared and the village had been razed to the

ground.

Some people erupted in fury on hearing this

news

…

and their bodies seemed to convulse with the

tremors of revolutionary pain

…

while others were

stunned into silence as they knew well that they would be

helpless against such a heavily-armed attack,

insignificant against the might of the French forces. It

would probably result in causing the French to further

increase their brutal attacks on innocent people, which, in

turn would have an awful effect on their agrarian

interests. What could a small district do when it is at the

mercy of one of the greatest states? What was the

solution?

They thought:

“

If it were only a question of our own

safety we would face it without a second thought, and

become martyrs for our

cause…

but we must think of the

defenceless women, the old people and innocent

children

...

we do not want callous men deciding the fate

of our vulnerable i

nnocents… O God…

please show us

Your Mercy…

O

Al’lah

...

Your Mercy…

!”

They

remained silent holding back the tears of pain and sadness

as if the slaughter was actually happening before their

eyes. An air of quiet confusion prevailed across the

country as they raised their hands in supplication to God,

invoking Him from the depth of their hearts and begging

Him to p

revent this impending massacre:

“

O

God…

Your

Mercy…

there are old men who have been devout for

their entire lives, innocent infants, and young children

among us

”

This silence, filled with fervent, silent prayer, was

interrupted by a

voice mumbling:

“

You know that

officer…

that

Syrian officer who helps the

rebels…

Sheikho…

haven’t you seen and heard about his

loyalty and sacrifices for his compatriots and

homeland

…

and his secret cooperation with the rebels

against France?

Everybody knows how he delivered all

the arms of Anjar Citadel to us and

Al’lah

saved him and

miraculously kept him from the hands of the

French…

and how he stopped the advance of many

expeditions to the various counties of Syria

by his clever

plans. Why don’t we ask his help to save us from this

impasse and prevent the terrible carnage that’s about to

befall all of us?”

Others replied:

“

What can he do in such a situation?

And what can he achieve alone if he is up against the

might and power of France…even his best and most

ingenious plans will be doomed to failure. We must keep

in mind that as a military officer under French rule he

must be careful not to reveal himself to them and oppose

them directly

…

so we doubt that he can help us

”

The first one replied:

“

But

Al’lah

may help him to

relieve us at his hands…

so why don’t we try, because

Al’lah

is the One to trust in all such matters, whether

great or small…

and even if we fail to make use of his

wonderful abilities, the situation could not get worse than

it is already

”

All of them agreed and one of them was

sent immediately to speak to

Mohammad Amin

, the

Syrian officer of whom they had been speaking.

The envoy reached the officer’s house in the evening,

where he was received with kind words of

encouragement, which instantly soothed his air of

desperation. Officer Sheikho sat with him as he related

the discussion that had taken place, and the great

suffering of the Syrian hierarchy and the insurgency

leaders because of this impending catastrophe.

Mohammad Amin

contemplated the facts of the

matter, and soon grasped the bitter reality; he listened to

this dreadful news as though it was a terrible nightmare

unfolding before him and wondered what the fate of the

country, and its people, would be if this full-scale French

military invasion went ahead, God forbid, on the French

pretext that they would shell only the sites of the terrorist

insurgents. They had failed to disclose that they were

intent on destroying it completely, and shedding the

blood of many, many innocents.

What could possibly be done to thwart this final

decision taken by the cruel, murderous French

government? He pondered the matter further and

experienced the full bitterness of such terrible

news

…

certainly it would be fruitless to face them, and if

it did come to pass, there would be countless victims, and

far more indescribable destruction than if the situation

were handled in a different way.

So

Mohammad Amin

resorted to

Al’lah

with all

sincerity: the news was extremely grave as he knew well

what France was capable of doing under such a trumped-

up pretext.

He turned to God in supplication:

“

O God! How can

the Syrian people escape?

”

Within a few

quiet moments

filled with silent prayer, entreating

Al’lah

, a plan flashed

into his mind which would ensure a way out of this

terrible situation: by

God’s

Will. A look full of hope and

confidence in God crossed his face, denoting new found

optimism, for he was certain that

Al’lah

would repel

those cruel aggressors and prevent them destroying his

country.

He said to the envoy:

“

Listen to me man

…

Go to

your comrades at once and tell them that Officer

Mohammad Amin

sends them his best regards and asks

you to search the entire district for a skilful artist;

if you

don’t have one, we know an excellent, gifted artist; then

tell him to draw and paint the best and most perfect

picture of the city of Holy Jerusalem

...

it must be very

big

...

then let everyone work together to fix it to the wall

of the first house to be seen by all who arrive in

this

country; then the problem will be solved by

God’s

Will

”

The man replied:

“

Is that all, Sir? And the problem

will be solved? But how? It seems too easy

”

Mohammad Amin

said:

“

As I have told you

…

don’t

delay

…

carry out the plan quickly. Ask the artist to

execute the work to the very best of his ability

…

and as

quickly as possible

...

and remember that

Al’lah

is the

One we trust to guide us in all matters

”

The man left promptly to carry the message to all

leaders of the rebellion, whatever their level of authority.

They quickly grasped the aim of

Mohammad Amin

...

so

they carried out his advice. It seemed like no time at all

when the wonderful painting was fixed to the wall of the

first house on the main road leading into the district. It

covered the wall entirely and was in full view of everyone

entering the city. It was a picture that represented Holy

Jerusalem and was so huge that it could be seen from far

away.

The fateful time had come for the French military

expedition to start moving into position to shell the entire

district. The expedition proceeded with many military

personnel of various ranks, and a vast amount of military

impedimenta and heavy armaments, headed by one of the

French commandants who had previously demonstrated

great brutality in dealing with the people of Syria. He was

fully determined to bomb the entire district on the pretext

of attacking the terrorist rebels in their strongholds and

hideouts.

As he approached the district he could not fail to see

the enormous painting from far. He was using his field-

glasses to scan the land and prepare to give his orders to

the tank crews and heavy-artillery soldiers to open

fire

...

but what was that on the horizon? He called his

adjutants and asked them to turn their field-glasses

towards the entrance gate of the district, then he asked

them:

“

Do you see what I see?

”

Surely, a painting of

Jerusalem was not what he expected to see!

They replied:

“

Yes

...

the people of this village must

be Christians, without any doubt. So…the whole area

must be Christian too

...

which means that most of its

people are our brothers in religion…

and they couldn’t

possibly do what we have heard about them…

we have no

reason to destroy them. We have been given false

information and whoever reported it must be punished

”

Their angry outbursts soon dissipated and the

commander cooled down

...

.

he thought the best decision

would be to withdraw and abandon all plans to shell the

territory.

At once, he phoned the high commander of the

French army in the government house and informed him

of the situation; and the reply was simply:

“

So…

it is a Christian area

...

the news which was

reported to us by our spies was definitely wrong

...

retreat

...

let the people live in peace

”

The expedition leader replied:

“

Yes, Sir

...

that’s my

opinion too

...

we shall withdraw immediately

”

He quickly gave orders to the division to withdraw

and return their terrible heavy armaments to the garrison.

By this action, Syria was saved from a dreadful fate

which would surely have lead to its eventual destruction.

Released from the terrible nightmare, the people returned

to living in safety, peace, and tranquillity.

Yes…God had answered their prayers and saved

them from grave danger and bloodshed: the loss of their

crops which would have been burnt and scattered by the

wind

...

the destruction of their houses which would have

collapsed if fired on, burying the people inside.

The threat of wholesale slaughter was removed when

Al’lah

the Almighty inspired that true, obedient

commander with His impressive Plan, for Mohammad

Amin

was always ready to suppress lies and

misinformation and support the truth, his compatriots and

his beloved homeland.

Our wise man employed extreme wisdom in his

defence of the truth, and against the corruption of

people’s hearts whilst cleverly concealing his behaviour

from the French; his success came because he placed his

trust in

Al’lah

to guide him in all his actions to support

the rebels against France.

In fact, France suspected his duplicity but had no

proof or evidence. Many times they tried to get rid of

him, but

Al’lah

willed that he should fulfil his high aims

in supporting the truth, and His merciful Providence

intervened miraculously in every difficult situation to

save him from certain death and preserve him from the

cunning of France; for

Al’lah

is the Steering God and He

would never humiliate someone who is truly obedient and

faithful to Him.

So, with his sharp ingenuity, enlightened by

Al’lah’s

Light,

Mohammad Amin

was able to guide the people of

this county with a ploy that ensured their safety and

thereby spared them bloodshed and destruction.

Truly, it was the outcome of real communication

with God, the fruit of Godly love, and a man’s

unshakeable belief in Him.

chapters.html:
Lesson

nineteen

Thinking

Sincerely Drives Spirit to Reality

The Holy

Qur'an

is

Al’lah’s

speech, which has been

revealed from the Almighty God to all humankind

through the Envoy of God (cpth). It includes the steps of

the straight path and the wise guidance that bring

humankind to happiness and pleasure in every time and

every place.

Our lesson will be presented by the famous scholar

and thinker Dr. Mustafa Mahmud, through his speech, he

says:

Some people argued with me, they were affected by

inclined destroying thoughts of atheism and disbelief and

had rejected the reality of the

Qur'an

as It is the final holy

Divine book.

In the beginning of the dispute I realized

that they didn’t know anything about Its scientific, social

literary … and moral facts, but they refused It depending

on the illogic criticism adopting the thoughts of a group

of

non Muslims who claimed that the Holy

Qur'an

is not

proper to be applied in this scientific era as it was written

during an old, primitive historic era whose events,

thoughts and life style don’t agree with our contemporary

times.

I answered them with a basic truth, that if their

claims were true that the

Qur'an

was written by

Mohammad since 1400 years ago, and after we reached

this developed science nowadays, surely we would see

that every line in It would be full of tomfoolery, silliness

and ridiculous words which make you laugh and laugh in

a hysterical state! What did you expect of a man who

couldn’t read or write during his entire life, then he

suddenly claimed that he was an Envoy of

Al’lah

Who

had bestowed upon him a Holy book to be a complete

constitution for all humankind? In the depth of that old

era of 1400 years ago, in a place called

‘

Mecca

’

far away

from civilization, surely you would expect that It would

be full of simple fakes, myth and funny jokes!

Absolutely that’s not right, vice versa, we find that

the holy

Qur'an

is the top of logic and cosmic sciences and

of scientific and spiritual knowledge. Despite this grand

supremacy It discusses and solves all the cases, issues and

dilemma quietly and logically in astonishing way, It has

brought up a glorious and intelligent people during the

years, and the thinkers all over the world have

harmonized with It where the nations rushed to enter in

Islam. Thus three quarters of the people of the world

entered in Islam and abandoned their previous religion,

how could human change his religion easily? That’s

impossible

...

Let us assume that someone or even more

changed their religion, it would never have happened for

a complete nation to abandon its inherited religion and

convert into a new one, except when this religion had

been a true Divine one.

Many nations abandoned their old religions

converting into Islam, adopting and respecting the holy

Qur'an

, so absolutely this is the holy Book of the

Almighty

Al’lah

and Islam is the final rescuing religion of

Al’lah

. Nations from China, from many countries beyond

China, from India, from north Asia, from all Arab areas

and Turkey, from countries beside Turkey, from the

extended areas in Africa and from Europe, all these

nations converted into Islam and holy

Qur'an

.

However, after a very long time we find that the

Holy

Qur'an

is without any differences or any changes and

even one letter was not changed, neither adding nor

removing even one letter, so how Grand It is! And how

Supreme It is! Despite the continuous hostility of

disbelievers against Islam during the old ages and in this

time

,

no one could misstate

it

.

Actually we have seen the

interpolations just in the books of interpretations of holy

Qur'an

and Islam (books written by some people)

which

imputed some false things (deeds or speeches) to the

noble Prophet (cpth), but that absolutely never happened

to the Holy

Qur'an

, Why?

Is it possible to a book authored by a human to be

kept with that

wondrous and unearthly keeping?

!

“

Verily We: It is we Who have sent down the

Qur'an

and surely, We will guard It

”

The Holy Qur’an,

Fortress ﴿15﴾ , Al-Hijr (Stone Building), verse ﴿10﴾

Throughout the old ages many nations who entered

in Islam were affected by It

and Its holy Book

“

the Holy

Qur'an

”

but they never affected It or changed It during

their weakness

’

days!

Keeping the holy

Qur'an

is an important issue which

chapters.title: Lesson Twenty Three
chapters.html:
The

Philosophy of the Veil in

Islam

Before starting to talk about the veil let’s take a

quick look at marriage in our human society and on the

other hand adultery. ﴿1﴾

-

Marriage: is the originator of the first social

rules because it is the founder of the family and it is, as

we know, the first link in the chains of the greater

community. It is also a device for setting out a beautiful

life immersed in affection and intimacy. The upbringing

of boys and girls in a family milieu imbibes them with

fine feelings from their first days of life, and promotes in

them the friendly feelings that prepare them for a future

life filled with mercy and clemency. If there had been no

marriage, the human race would have been extinguished a

very long time ago. The perpetuation of life and its

continuity on this earth require prosperity and the

continuance of marriage ﴿2﴾

-

Adultery: is a very retroactive act. It is the

driver of corruption in the community, the propagator of

chaos, and is lethal to progeny. When a young man rushes

at whoredom, he catches an axe in his both hands in order

to destroy the pillars of the nation.

Suppose that the young man hooked a girl in this

errant way. He will spend a long time with her, but he

will be bored of her when he sees her beauty withering in

the hands of the years. He will forsake her for another

woman. He will leave her at the door of aging, liable to

misery and poverty. Even if she could find a job to keep

her at subsistence level, what about her fate if she became

ailing for work? How hard life is! How her pains are

aching in deprivation of a husband and children!

-

The social results of adultery: If we want to

comment on the single young man who will get used to

the way of adultery in his future, we shall find the

desertion of marital life so as to continue to abandon the

marriage: all his life going on along this despicable way,

and he will not cherish a family life or participate in

reviving the community, he will be liable to the diseases

arising from this life. He is no more than a destroying axe

of the happiness of every young woman with whom he

makes illegal relation. When youth is gone and old age

comes, this frivolous man will not find a supporting son

beside him and not even a beloved relative. Then sorrows

will pervade him, and misery will burn him in the dark

evening of his life.

-

Disaffection and coolness: If he marries a pretty

girl when his freshness begins slanting towards wilting,

after a long time spent in the arms of prostitutes, no

wonder he seeks a good-looking woman. But this tender

woman he chose; being in her prime of youth will not be

happy, in his company after he has passed a long course

of his life.

A charming beautiful wife will not like to live with a

husband in the evening of his life. Her eyes will look for

men of better health and who are younger than him and

all of a sudden she will walk into adultery to bring forth

illegal children for her legal husband. If this father dies,

the illegal brothers will share the inheritance with their

legal brothers from the mother-side. Thus corruption will

prevail in this miserable shattered house.

If that young wife could restrain the caprice of her

sexual desire and she forbore herself and did not follow

the road to prostitution, her aspirations will remain

suppressed and her spirit covered in sorrows. Suffice it to

say, about the ruination that befalls the children of that

family, due to the fragile sentimental relationship

between the father and the mother, they will inherit feeble

formation, which I shall elucidate after a while.

Thus life

will never be serene for the adulterer and the adulteress

even if they enter a legal marital life. Ennui and boredom

will spread over a life covered with sorrows, and their

cauterized hearts will have been spoilt by sin and smeared

by crime. This is the destiny of adultery.

-

Misery: It is the cause of misery for both sexes in

their future life. It is the attenuation and annihilation of

the offspring, the extirpator of virtues from the horizons

of life, and the eraser of happiness from the pages of life

too. Any aggression on honor is accompanied with an

aggression which covers all other social affairs. How

wide the difference is between the results of marital life

and the life of adultery and sin. In the former, virtues

thrive, and fine feelings grow, and the atmosphere is

saturated with harmony and sympathy, while in the latter,

the instincts are in control and man is degraded to the

level of an animal. The instincts will dispel the upper

humane affections, and there will be a gloomy future,

void of the sympathy of relatives and the help of progeny.

The

Unveiling and How It Affects the Society:

What has been reported by actual state of life!

First:

The sexual instinct is inborn in every living

creature, and it is liable to be excited on viewing beauty

and the charm of the body. As long as man eats and

drinks, the material of life from which he was created

originates in his body. It will remain there and will come

out when it

is aroused by charm and beauty.

Second:

The morals that grew and integrated cannot

destroy the sexual instinct forces, but they can direct

them towards Good. Moreover, complete morals cannot

change the present psychic laws. These remarks will be

clear when tackling the subject of the veiling and the

unveiling.

The unveiling leads to the deterioration of the

community in the direction of vice, it contains the

breakup of the ties of family life. It is the cause of

weakness of progeny formation, and the sewer of

alienation, dissension and severity in the home and for its

youth.

Finally, unveiling eliminates satisfaction from the

spirits of the people, and it evokes their discontent, and

under the shadows of discontent nothing grows save

human misery and social suffering.

The explanation and the elucidation. Let us first

discuss the effects of unveiling on the spirit of the single

young man and on the spirit of the single young woman.

Whatsoever is said about supporting the unveiling from

the embellishments of speech, the real facts refute this.

They say that if the morals are integrated and become

strong in the two sexes, then the unveiling will not cause

deterioration and breakup. I say: even if the morals grew

and integrated they cannot destroy the sexual potency.

Whenever beautiful faces loom at the thirsty young man,

and tender voices talk to him, he cannot but tend towards

pinup girls in the grip of the infatuation of beauty. This is

the first step towards adultery, and you can say the same

thing about the thirsty girl. She will slip herself to her

young friend, and if we do not want to take into

consideration the types of vices that reality offers to us as

a result of these first social connections, it is enough to

say that these connections develop anxiety and arouse

sleeplessness. So, how could youth continue in building

up the future and remain faithful to work and to study

after the feelings become vivid with the spectrum of

sexual life, and the barrages are set up, and the valve of

instinct is called upon to commit sin?

In fact, instinct is blind and it does not differentiate

between Good and Evil; and even if thought can

overcome it after it has been awakened by the sight of the

pinups and it is shackled in cuffs, that is sheer

suppression, which is more evil and calamitous: two

struggling forces in the square of the spirit, the force of

the raging crazy instinct and the force of conscious

distinguishing thought. If the conscious force overcame

the other, the spirit would enter the pain of depression

and instinct would stay in anger until it found feeding;

but if the first force overcame the second, that would be

the worst.

A community constricted with unveiling will never

know the way of the reassurance of the hearts of its

youths, because the factors of excitation will be active

and the sexual motive will be agitated. It is seen in those

milieus where unveiling and celibacy prevail that all

conversation for pleasure is linked with the milestones of

sexual communication, or something similar, because

these kinds of jokes become so instinctive. This is to

satiate the instinctive thirst which has been inflamed by

the catastrophe of unveiling!

Could anyone believe that the Godly Hand that

crowded this vast universe with the wonders of creation

and the grandeur of formation formed these spirits in a

condition of fearful rottenness and sheer decline? Nay!

The Hand formed these spirits pure and stainless, but the

ways in which they behave have spoilt them. Unveiling

exposes both sexes to the charm of the visual, and the

visual leads to talks sown with expressions of endearment

and flirtation, and after that to the deprived thirst which

leads to drinking from the basins of meanness and

harlotry.

The

Effect of Unveiling on the Class of Married

People:

The bonds that tie the hearts of men to their wives

begin to loosen, little by little, in a community where its

women are unveiled. The married man, although he is

satiated sexually, will look at women that are far better

than his wife in shapeliness and beauty. If his character is

strong enough to keep himself from deviation, it does not

prevent him from desiring and lamenting. He will wish

for a wife like the one he is looking at, in her grace and

her beauty. The wish will increase with the passing of

days and with more meetings with beautiful unveiled

women. These wishes will change into lamentations

inside himself and he will become resentful because of

his bad luck. The same thing can be said about his wife

who was seen by men and who saw men. Surely she will

meet a man that possesses some factors that put him

above her husband in superiority, and in many other

traits. She will take the first step and the second step, i.e.,

in wishing and lamenting…

Now let us concentrate on this family and see what

will follow:

Coolness of passion between them will result, for the

heart of each one is attached to someone else other than

their companion. He or she will not see in his or her

companion anything save a person with whom he or she

will unfortunately spend the rest of their life. In this

world there are many husbands who are better than this

husband, and there are many wives who are more

beautiful than this woman. This is the fixed idea that will

be concentrated in the minds of the spouses in the

community of the unveiling, and it will surely weaken the

sexual marital bonds between them.

Practical scientific researchers showed that the

coolness between the man and his wife is reflected in

sexual copulation in its worst form, because the loss of

the flaming affection between the couple leads to the

weakness of their offspring’s tender physiological

formation. When affection is activated and strong, it will

produce a lot of Good at the time of the instinctive sexual

intercourse. It has the most effect in producing children

of sound bodies and normal formation, and vice versa.

Most ailments that are contracted to children are usually

inherited because of estrangement concentrated in the

spirits of their parents when they meet in a marital

approach.

It can be added that the waning of affection from the

atmosphere of the house makes the children live in a

medium arid of affection. This will be reflected in their

fresh spirits and it will implant the seeds of hardness in

their hearts while they are at the doorstep of life, and

make them stamp on it because of their grudge.

Finally, unveiling scatters consent from the spirits of

people as I said, and it creates resentment in their hearts

regarding their ill-luck and life. It is said that happiness

can never be realized in a certain community unless the

element of consent is fulfilled among the individuals of

that community, because the lamenter for ill-luck is

wretched even if he wallows in luxury. Nothing can evoke

happiness in life as consent does. In the Holy

Qur'an

,

there is not one verse that orders the women to unveil

their faces, but on the contrary, the order has been issued

by

Al’lah

the Almighty to cover all the body and the face

completely.

Now let us listen to the Word of God and He is the

most Omniscient of the laws of obedient men and the

ways of their Good, and He is Loving and Merciful

towards them. He orders the veil to be worn and shows its

wisdom to the Ladies of the Messenger (cpth) who are the

examples for the Muslim women to follow. God

said:

“…and when ye ask (his Ladies) for anything ye

want, ask them from behind a screen, that makes for

greater purity for your hearts and for theirs…”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress ﴿33﴾ Al-Ahzab (The

Combined Clans), verse ﴿53﴾ .

Since there is unveiling of the face, as they claim,

so, where is the screen?

The Definition of the Veil in Language and

L

egislation:

In language the veil is to curtain vision completely or

to lose sight. This Fortress explains the veil and it does

not accept it unless it is used to screen all the beauties of

the woman, the container that fills the heart with desire,

and contaminates it by the germ of libido, and keeps from

the woman only her speech from behind a curtain. God

said:

“O consorts of the Prophet! Ye are not like any of

the (other) women: if ye achieved

Al’lah’s

Light (being

protected against ill-desires), be not too complaisant of

speech, lest one, in whose heart is disease, should be

moved with desire…”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress ﴿33﴾ Al-

Ahzab (The Combined Clans), verse ﴿32﴾ .

Speech, despite the covering veil and the hindrance

in seeing the beautiful face, must be very serious and

resolute and tenderness must never come through it in

dialect or fineness of tone or statement, and there must be

no extremity in subject.

God has ordered women to stay at home where their

valuable productive work lies in bringing up boys and

girls and in preparing the future generation to be sound in

body and mind. But if they were obliged to go out, they

must be refined by following jurisprudence for

safeguarding themselves for the public character and for

the safety of the hearts of all people. God said:

“And stay

in your houses and make not a dazzling display, like that

of the former Times of Ignorance

...”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress ﴿33﴾ Al-Ahzab (The Combined Clans), verse ﴿33﴾ .

I would like to mention the honorable ayah (verse)

from An-Nur Fortress, which describes to us the complete

social system, which was prescribed for the ideal life on

earth. God said:

“Say to the believing men that they

should lower their gaze and guard their modesty: that

will make for greater purity for them; and

Al’lah

is

Well-Acquainted with all that they do. And say to the

believing women that they should lower their gaze and

guard their modesty; that they should not display their

beauty and ornaments except what (must ordinarily)

appear thereof; that they should draw their veils over

their body openings and not display their beauty except

to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands’ fathers,

their sons, their husbands’ sons, their brothers or their

brothers’ sons, or their sisters’ sons, or their women, or

the slaves whom their right hands possess, or male

servants free of physical needs, or small children who

have no sense of shame of sex; and that they should not

strike their feet in order not to draw attention to their

hidden ornaments. And O ye Believers turn ye all

together towards

Al’lah

in repentance, that you may

attain Blissful consequences.”

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress ﴿24﴾ An-Nur (Light), verse

(30-31).

From these two Ayahs we see the decencies of

walking, which the woman considers while she is on the

road. The veil (al-kh

e

m

a'

ar) is the screening cover. The

word is taken from the root ‘khamara’ which means to

cover, and the ‘khamr’ and ‘khamra’ (wine) because wine

covers ‘consciousness’ and closes ‘thought’ and covers it.

For this reason the ayah orders us to let down the veil that

covers the face as far as the visible neck from the upper

opening of the garment and the upper area of the chest.

All that is exaggeration for covering beauty, which the

verse calls adornment (zeenah), for beauty is the natural

adornment of women and juvenility as well.

He who has an expensive dear jewel, surely hides it

away from the eyes of people and thieves in order not to

have it stolen from him. So is it with his heart’s ‘precious

jewel’. He safeguards and preserves it. Thus

woman’s

value and prestige in Islam appears clearly.

The Almighty has described to us the state of the

believing woman in Paradise saying:

“And with them will

be chaste females, restraining their glances (desiring

none except their husbands), with wide and beautiful

eyes…

”

she lowers her gaze because of shyness.

“…as

chaste as the sheltered eggs”

pure from impurities, so

she is veiled and seen by none except her husband.

The Holy

Qur'an

,

Fortress ﴿37﴾ As-Saffat (Those who

Set Ranks), verse (48-49).

Indeed, if the women of

Paradise are veiled from the others, how should the

women of this lower life be then? All the

woman’s

charms which

Al’lah

the Almighty adorned her with from

the beauties of face, eyes, mouth, teeth, hair, juvenility,

youth, and others have been named in the Holy

Qur'an

as

‘

adornment’, and since unveiling these charms to the ones

other than the husband, the father, the brother, the son or

anyone of the unmarriageable men listed in the noble

verse causes charisma and corruption in the land, such as

drives to adultery, and stirs up discord between man and

his wife after he has seen the one whose face is more

beautiful than his wife’s, and who has a better impression

or position in his spirit than hers.

Therefore, and for

uprooting corruption from the land, maintaining the

family and its happiness, and preventing the factors of

weakness and looseness from sneaking in, Islam orders

the women not to show these beauties to other than the

unmarriageable men when the Almighty says:

“…

and not

display their beauty except to their husbands, their

fathers, their husbands’ fathers, their sons, their

husbands’ sons, their brothers, or their brothers’ sons,

or their sisters’ sons, or their women…”

The Almighty

has ordered the young woman to walk normally on the

road so that her youth and juvenility, which

Al’lah

the

Almighty has adorned her with, do not appear:

“…and

that they should not strike their feet in order to draw

Al’lah

chapters.title: LessonTwenty Four
chapters.html:
Lesson

Twenty Four

The Story of

“

the Veil and the French

Woman

”

A meeting was held between the Eminent Scholar

Mohammad Amin

Sheikho and a certain person of high

social and cultural class. The man had a ‘doctorate’ at the

time of tutorships and no school. The meeting had

something to do with the inauguration of Prince

Abdulmajeed Haidar, a king over the Great Syria at the

time of the French mandate, and he had been given the

green light from the French government.

On the next day and at the same fixed date the

Eminent Scholar

Mohammad Amin

Sheikho came to that

man’s house and knocked at the door. When he felt that a

woman was at the door, he gave her his back.

She was obliged to tell him that her husband would

be ten minutes late because of an important matter with

General

Sarrail

, the supreme French commander in Syria.

So he descended the steps and waited in the street near

the

house.

The doctor apologized for being late. Our man

answered:

“

to be late for ten minutes is not considered

lateness

”

.

Then they entered the house and sat in the saloon.

Before the talk for which the meeting was held, the wife

of the doctor and her daughter came to attend the

meeting. He looked at her husband who knew that

Mohammad Amin

Sheikho was not in the habit of sitting

with gentle sex. The husband looked, then dropped his

head and did not utter a word because he saw his wife’s

face was covered with anger.

She began her talk saying:

“

I believed in your highly

good reputation, your international reputation in Lebanon.

I valued you very much. Now I see vice versa

”

.

He was obliged to reply through her daughter,

saying:

“

please tell your mother that she is a fool

”

.

When she knew the striking news, she became

excited and stood up crying:

“

Am I a fool?!

”

It is known

that the French always had hot temper

He told her:

“

of course… He who gives two

completely contradictory judgments upon a man whom he

does not know or meet

;

is really a fool! Did you see me

before, to give these two judgments?!

”

She answered:

“

yes; but why did not you enter the

villa when I invited you? Am I not beautiful? My husband

knows that I am one of the charming women of Paris, Did

you hear that I am not an honest woman so that you did

not enter? Here is my husband, ask him if he noticed

anything about me of such kind during my life with him?

”

Our Man answered:

“

I am a Muslim. One of the basic

things in our clear jurisprudence is that men keep to their

own world and women keep to theirs too. The joining of

the two sexes is taboo

”

.

She answered:

“

you, Muslims have exaggerated

much. The Jews are older than you are. The Christians are

more powerful than you are too. Where did you get this

veiling from?

”

He answered her:

“

is it a matter of oldness and power

or of logic, proof and rightness?

”

She said:

“

truly of evidence and proof

”

.

He said:

“

therefore, let me show the cause of the veil

between the man and the woman in Islam. When I do not

sit with gentle sex but only meet the harsh sex (the male

sex) all the day, and then I come back home from work, I

see only my wife as the most beautiful woman in the

world. My love for her increases

...

The bonds between

us become more powerful. This is very important for the

growth of my children, even upon the family level. When

we sit together; you and I are surely honest… You

certainly have charms and excellent characteristics that

exalt you above my wife.

I shall like these charms you

have; because I am a human being. When I return home,

the comparison begins unconsciously between what I saw

and liked of complete characteristics which I do not find

in my wife; then I shall lament ill-luck, and relate

injustice to my lot. Why did my wife become my lot! She

is not of that beauty, charm, and musical talk, or elegance

and the lightness of soul, or that attractiveness of yours.

These qualities will lessen my love for my wife. Hatred

will prevail between us instead of love and intimacy.

When my wife is nice to me as usual saying

“

O my

darling

”

, I feel as if I hear a bullet penetrating my ears,

because the heart is changed.

“God has not made two

hearts in a man…”

Love has changed and the spirit tends

towards the most beautiful and the most charming, the

more attractive and the finer.

Then the dispute prevails

instead of cooperation, and injustice instead of justice.

My wife may bear my bad treatment once or twice, but

her patience will come to an end. She will question

herself about the secret of this wonderful inversion,

which made him treat me like that in spite of doing my

duty towards him and my children in the best way. She

revolts and treats me the same, and here is the calamity.

There is tension in our relations. The quarrels begin for

the silliest cause and tempers are changed. Because of

this change, life becomes an unbearable hell. Divorce

becomes the only solution for salvation. We shall not

both reap the result of divorce only, but it will be

reflected upon the children who will lose in a moment

their guardian and they will become the friends of

misbehavior in the street,

“

the only place where they learn

the arts of vice and crime

”

. A quarrel will happen between

my family and hers too.

This dissolution has a very bad

effect on building up the community. Due to mixing and

unveiling, the community becomes disconnected and it is

very easy to be demolished. This is the result of our

mixing together; despite you and I being honest.

This is in relation to the man. But in relation to the

woman and through her meeting with a strange man, she

will like some characteristics in him such as: talk,

treatment, the outward appearance, the rank, etc…

These

qualities are not available in her husband. With the elapse

of time, this will lead to discord with her husband and the

beginning of disputes and quarrels

”

.

Then the Eminent Scholar looked at her and said:

“

if

you find good qualities in me… Wouldn’t you like these

qualities to be available in your husband?

”

She said:

“

I’d like my husband to be the best man in

the world

”

.

He said:

“

therefore, the absence of these qualities in

your husband will belittle him in your eyes, and his value

decreases in your view. The only cause of that is your

mixing with men other than your husband. This mixing

made you like some qualities in others, which are not

found in your husband, and the result is disgust and

repulsion instead of love and enjoyment; thus happiness

is lost

”

.

When she heard this logical discussion as a scientific

analysis of our practical situation, she looked at her

daughter and said:

“

I want you to become a Muslim like

this man but not like your father

”

.

Her husband dropped his head shamefully because

she knew that his behavior practises contradiction with

the spirit of a Muslim.

After

that,

the great Eminent Scholar took leave and

went home.

After a few days, the husband of the French woman

came to tell the honest master that his wife wanted to

meet him again for she had found in him true, real and

logical words… She might have the real wish to embrace

Islam if she could meet him again.

The Eminent Scholar apologized to her husband

saying:

“

my meeting with her for the first time was

obligatory, as I was obliged to reply to her accusation of

fanaticism within Islam with regard to the veil and of

inaction. Now I do not want to go to her on my legs and

by my own free will. In the first time, I saw her without

desire, but in the second time and to meet her by my own

will I shall desire her, I am a human being, my brother,

thus I ruin myself and this is not permissible, if she wants

to embrace Islam that is her free will

”

.

In less than a month, the doctor came back with his

French wife who was dressed in long clothes covering her

body, and with a cover on her hair. The Eminent Scholar

Mohammad Amin

Sheikho opened the door for them

without a date beforehand. He welcomed them and

permitted them to enter his house honorably. Then she

told him that she saw the Prophet Mohammad (cpth) in

her sleep in his light, grandeur and beauty, so she was

astounded and lived in sacred worlds and heavenly

delight and her spirit forsook her world for a lovely

paradise; she hated her desires and wanted nothing other

than her high sublime state.

She added:

“

since the great

sight, I began to live a life full of happiness and

enjoyment where my pain was changed into matchless

felicity. I am still living it; for this reason I decided to

declare my Islam at your hands

”

, and she embraced Islam.

Yes, this real story occurred during the French

mandate over Syria.

Then he added:

“

after embracing Islam you have to

cover your face in order to continue your elevated cordial

life, for we do not accept harmful charm

”

.

She answered:

“

I cannot apply it now in one lot,

because all my life I used to uncover my face. So it is

difficult to apply it at present

”

.

She asked him to be patient with her a little and she

would accomplish that in accordance with God Will, and

in love for his Messenger (cpth).

The political troubles that stormed Damascus did not

let them meet again, but he was reassured of her

truthfulness. He was sure that she would accomplish

everything by

God’s

Will.
